words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子撬动那块大石头。
words.en: A lever is a handle that you pull or push to operate a machine. It can also refer to a rigid bar pivoted about a fulcrum, used to transfer a force to a load and usually to provide a mechanical advantage.

words.tr: v. 反复地说；重申；重述
words.ex: He reiterate that he is sorry.
words.ex_cn: 他反复地说他很抱歉。
words.en: If you reiterate something, you say it again, usually in order to emphasize it.

words.ex: The sky is overcast today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空多云。
words.en: If the sky or the day is overcast, it is covered with cloud; dull and not sunny.

words.ex: He drinks coffee on the balcony every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在阳台上喝咖啡。
words.en: A balcony is a platform on the outside of a building, enclosed by walls or balustrades, supported by columns or console brackets. The platform is projected from the wall of a building, usually above the ground floor.

words.ex: It is apparent that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is apparent, it seems to be true, although you cannot be certain that it is.

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.tr:
n. 病房；病室；选区；
v. 监护；守护；挡住；
words.ex: The patient is in ward 5.
words.ex_cn: 病人在5号病房。
words.en: A ward is a separate room in a hospital, typically one allocated to a particular type of patient, or a person, especially a child, who is under the protection or care of a legal guardian or a court.

words.tr:
v. 陷入（困境）；设圈套；
n. 圈套；陷阱；困境；
words.ex: He trapped himself in debt by spending too much.
words.ex_cn: 他因花钱太多而陷入债务困境。
words.en: A trap is a device or enclosure designed to catch and retain animals, typically by allowing entry but not exit or by catching hold of a part of the body.

words.ex: His refusal to apologize made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝道歉，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: The act of refusing to do something or to accept something.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: This rule pertains to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If one thing pertains to another, it relates, belongs, or applies to it.

words.tr:
n. 轨道；
v. 绕...轨道而行；
words.ex: The moon moves around the Earth in an orbit.
words.ex_cn: 月亮围绕地球在轨道上运行。
words.en: An orbit is the curved path, usually elliptical, described by a planet, satellite, spaceship, etc., around a celestial body, as the sun.

words.tr:
adv. 向前；前进；
v. 促进；转交；
adj. 向前的；前进的；
words.ex: He walked forward to meet the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去见老师。
words.en: If you move or look forward, you move or look in a direction that is in front of you. In British English, you can also say that you are looking forward to something that is going to happen.

words.ex: He eats a cucumber for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一根黄瓜。
words.en: A cucumber is a long, green vegetable with a high water content, used in salads and for pickling.

words.tr:
adj. 辅助的；附属的
n. 辅助物；附属物；助动词
words.ex: He used an auxiliary verb to form the past tense.
words.ex_cn: 他使用了一个助动词来构成过去时。
words.en: An auxiliary is a person or thing that provides additional help or support.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.tr: v. 使安静；安慰；使缓和
words.ex: She sang a song to soothe the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她唱了一首歌来安抚婴儿。
words.en: To soothe someone means to make them feel calmer and less anxious, upset, or angry.

words.ex: The piston moves up and down in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 活塞在发动机中上下移动。
words.en: A piston is a component of reciprocating engines, reciprocating pumps, gas compressors and pneumatic cylinders, among other similar mechanisms. It is the moving component that is contained by a cylinder and is made gas-tight by piston rings.

words.ex: The beer left foam on the top of the glass.
words.ex_cn: 啤酒在杯子顶部留下了一层泡沫。
words.en: Foam is a mass of small bubbles that are formed in or on a liquid.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: She bought a warm wrap for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 她买了一件保暖的包裹（披肩）过冬。
words.en: To cover or enclose something in paper, cloth, or other material.

words.ex: The crowd cheered loudly at the stadium.
words.ex_cn: 观众在体育场里大声欢呼。
words.en: A stadium is a large structure for open-air sports or entertainments, consisting of a field or stage surrounded partly or completely by a tiered structure designed to allow spectators to stand or sit and view the event.

words.ex: The engagement between the teacher and students improved learning.
words.ex_cn: 老师与学生之间的密切关系提高了学习效果。
words.en: An engagement is a formal agreement to get married, or a period of time when two people are planning to get married.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: The old wall began to crumble after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 旧墙在雨后开始坍塌。
words.en: If something crumbles, or if you crumble it, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: He bought a new accessory for his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的手机买了一个新配件。
words.en: An accessory is something such as a bag or piece of jewelry that you wear or carry because it is attractive.

words.tr:
v. 伪造；假装；冒充；
adj. 假的；冒充的；伪造的；
words.ex: He faked a signature to get the money.
words.ex_cn: 他伪造了一个签名来拿到钱。
words.en: If something is fake, it is not real, genuine, or true, but is made to appear so.

words.tr:
v. 沉思
n. （作家、画家等的）灵感；缪斯
words.ex: He often muses about the meaning of life.
words.ex_cn: 他常常沉思生命的意义。
words.en: In Greek mythology, the Muses are the goddesses of the inspiration of literature, science and the arts. As a verb, to muse means to think about something carefully and for a long time.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.tr: adj. 高的；崇高的；傲慢的
words.ex: The mountain has a lofty peak.
words.ex_cn: 这座山有一个很高的山顶。
words.en: If you say that someone behaves in a lofty way, you are critical of them for behaving in a proud and rather unpleasant way, as if they think they are very important.

words.tr: v. 点燃；生火；激起；发亮
words.ex: He used a match to kindle the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他用火柴点燃了火。
words.en: To kindle something means to cause it to begin burning or to arouse or inspire it.

words.tr: adj. 不可避免的；必定的；
words.ex: It is inevitable that the sun will rise tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳明天一定会升起。
words.en: If something is inevitable, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: His outlook on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的观点非常积极。
words.en: Your outlook is your general attitude towards life.

words.ex: The children explored a dark cavern.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们探索了一个黑暗的洞穴。
words.en: A cavern is a large cave or a large chamber in a cave.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: The old cemetery is near the church.
words.ex_cn: 那个古老的墓地在教堂附近。
words.en: A cemetery is a place where dead people are buried.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.ex: Her smile has a special charm.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑有一种特别的魅力。
words.en: If you say that someone has charm, you mean that they behave in a friendly and pleasant way that makes people like them. A charm is also a small ornament that is fixed to a bracelet or necklace.

words.tr: n. 回路；环行；电路；巡回；
words.ex: The battery connects to the circuit to make the light work.
words.ex_cn: 电池连接到回路，使灯亮起来。
words.en: A circuit is a roughly circular line, route, or movement that starts and finishes at the same place. It can also refer to the complete path that an electric current travels along.

words.ex: He applied for citizenship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年申请了公民身份。
words.en: Citizenship is the status of being a citizen of a particular country.

words.ex: Don't bother to clean the room, I'll do it later.
words.ex_cn: 别麻烦去打扫房间了，我稍后会做。
words.en: To bother someone means to cause them trouble or to annoy them.

words.ex: He sang a mournful song at the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他在葬礼上唱了一首悲伤的歌。
words.en: If you are mournful, you are very sad.

words.ex: He gave an absolute yes to the offer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个提议给出了完全肯定的回答。
words.en: Absolute means complete and total, or not limited in any way.

words.ex: This rule is applicable to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则适用于所有学生。
words.en: If something is applicable to a particular situation, it is relevant or suitable for that situation.

words.tr:
n. 袭击；罢工；
v. 击打；侵袭；突然想到；
words.ex: The strike on the base happened at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 对基地的袭击发生在黎明时分。
words.en: To hit someone or something forcefully; to stop work as a form of protest.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: He extinguished the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水把火扑灭了。
words.en: To extinguish a fire or a light means to stop it burning or shining.

words.ex: I took a cab to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 我打了一辆出租车去机场。
words.en: A cab is a taxi, a vehicle that carries passengers for a fare, usually calculated by a meter.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.tr:
v. 避开；躲避
n. 躲避；诡计
words.ex: He dodged the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速躲开了球。
words.en: If you dodge, you move quickly, often to avoid being hit, caught, or seen.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.ex: The little girl drew a mermaid in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩画了一条海里的美人鱼。
words.en: A mermaid is a mythical sea creature with the head and upper body of a woman and the tail of a fish.

words.ex: The soldiers raided the enemy camp at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间突袭了敌人的营地。
words.en: A raid is a sudden attack on a place by soldiers, police, or other officials, in order to search for something or to arrest someone.

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: The dragon is an imaginary creature.
words.ex_cn: 龙是一种想象中的生物。
words.en: An imaginary person, place, or thing is one that does not exist or is not real, but that people think about or talk about.

words.ex: I asked for a refund after the product broke.
words.ex_cn: 产品坏了之后，我要求退款。
words.en: A refund is a sum of money that is returned to you, for example because you have paid too much or because you have returned goods to a shop.

words.ex: The worker had long exposure to loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 这名工人长期暴露在噪音中。
words.en: The condition of being exposed to something, especially to something harmful or unpleasant.

words.tr:
n. 社论；
adj. 编辑的；
words.ex: The newspaper published an editorial about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 报纸发表了一篇关于气候变化的社论。
words.en: An editorial is an article in a newspaper which gives the opinion of the editor or publisher on a topic or item of news.

words.tr:
n. 名声；名誉；名望
v. 认为；以为
words.ex: He is of good repute in his town.
words.ex_cn: 他在镇上声誉很好。
words.en: The opinion generally held of someone or something; the state of being regarded in a particular way.

words.ex: The dictator ruled the country for many years.
words.ex_cn: 这位独裁者统治这个国家很多年。
words.en: A dictator is a ruler who has complete power in a country, especially when this power has been obtained by force and is used unfairly or cruelly.

words.tr:
n. 垫；爪垫；便笺簿
v. 放轻脚步走
words.ex: She put a pad on the chair for comfort.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个垫子以增加舒适感。
words.en: A pad is a flat piece of material that is used to protect something, to make something more comfortable, or to absorb liquid.

words.ex: The dog has a hairy back.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗的背部有浓密的毛。
words.en: Having a lot of hair, especially on the body; covered with hair.

words.tr:
adj. 南极的；
n. 南极地区；
words.ex: The antarctic ice is melting fast.
words.ex_cn: 南极的冰正在迅速融化。
words.en: The Antarctic is the area around the South Pole, characterized by its cold climate and ice-covered landscapes.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.tr: n. 运作方式；力学；“mechanic”的复数；
words.ex: The mechanics of this machine are simple to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的运作方式很简单易懂。
words.en: Mechanics is the branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on bodies and with motion, comprised of kinetics, statics, and kinematics.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: The beach has sandy soil.
words.ex_cn: 这个海滩有含沙的土壤。
words.en: Covered with or consisting mostly of sand.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: The apples ripen in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天成熟。
words.en: When crops ripen or when the sun ripens them, they become ripe and ready to eat.

words.ex: The box has a cubic shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是立方体形状的。
words.en: Relating to or involving the cube or cubes.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: He rowed the boat with an oar.
words.ex_cn: 他用桨划船。
words.en: An oar is a long pole with a wide, flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat.

words.ex: They traverse the forest to reach the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们横穿森林去到达村庄。
words.en: To traverse something means to move or travel across it, often with some difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.tr: adj. 工业化的； v. “industrialize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The country became industrialized in the 20th century.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在20世纪实现了工业化。
words.en: An industrialized country or area has a lot of industries and factories.

words.tr: adj. 持久的；恒久的； v. 持续；“last”的现在分词；
words.ex: The friendship between them is lasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的友谊是持久的。
words.en: Something that is lasting continues to exist or have an effect for a very long time.

words.ex: The succession of rain made the ground wet.
words.ex_cn: 连续的雨水使地面变湿了。
words.en: A succession of things of the same kind is a number of them that exist or happen one after the other.

words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.ex: The village sent a tribute of grain to the king.
words.ex_cn: 村庄向国王进贡了谷物。
words.en: A tribute is something that you say, do, or make to show your admiration and respect for someone.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.tr:
adj. 抽象的；非具体的；
n. 摘要；概要；抽象派艺术作品；
words.ex: The painting shows an abstract shape.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画展示了一个抽象的形状。
words.en: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

words.tr:
n. 浸泡；
v. 吸收；
words.ex: The clothes went into a soak overnight.
words.ex_cn: 衣服泡了一整晚。
words.en: To soak something means to make it very wet by leaving it in a liquid, or to become very wet in this way. It can also mean to absorb or take in something.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful representation of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是对自然的美丽表现。
words.en: A representation of something is a picture, a model of it, or a description of it that you create or that someone else creates for you.

words.ex: He had to endure the cold winter without a coat.
words.ex_cn: 他不得不在没有外套的情况下忍受寒冷的冬天。
words.en: To endure means to suffer something difficult, unpleasant, or painful, or to continue to exist for a long time.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；一刹那；
v. 闪光；闪现；
words.ex: The camera captured a sudden flash of light.
words.ex_cn: 相机捕捉到了一道突然的闪光。
words.en: A flash is a sudden bright light that quickly disappears. As a verb, it means to shine brightly for a short time or to appear or pass suddenly.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.ex: He is invariably late for meetings.
words.ex_cn: 他总是开会迟到。
words.en: If something invariably happens or is invariably true, it always happens or is always true.

words.ex: She bought a new garment for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件新衣服。
words.en: A garment is a piece of clothing; used especially in contexts where you are talking about the manufacture or sale of clothes.

words.ex: The rebellion against the king failed.
words.ex_cn: 反对国王的叛乱失败了。
words.en: A rebellion is an organized attempt to overthrow a government or authority by a group of people.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr:
n. 负荷；载重；
v. 载入；
words.ex: The bridge can't hold such a heavy load.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥承受不了这么重的负荷。
words.en: A load is a large quantity of something that is carried by a vehicle, person, or animal, or the amount of work that a person or machine has to do.

words.ex: The evolution of birds from dinosaurs took millions of years.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类从恐龙进化而来花了数百万年。
words.en: The gradual development of something, especially from a simple to a more complex form.

words.ex: The epidemic spread quickly across the country.
words.ex_cn: 这种流行病迅速蔓延到全国。
words.en: An epidemic is a large number of cases of an infectious disease occurring at the same time.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的； v. 改变；变化；使多样化；“vary”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The market sells varied fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售各种各样的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: If something is varied, it consists of things which are different from each other.

words.ex: The prophet told the people about the coming storm.
words.ex_cn: 预言者告诉人们即将到来的风暴。
words.en: A prophet is a person who is believed to be chosen by God to lead the people and to tell them what God wants them to do.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.tr: adj. 东方的（尤指中国和日本）
words.ex: He bought an oriental rug at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一张东方地毯。
words.en: Oriental is used to describe things that come from or are associated with eastern Asia, especially China and Japan.

words.ex: His neck was stiff after sleeping wrong.
words.ex_cn: 他睡姿不对，脖子变得僵硬。
words.en: If something is stiff, it is firm and does not bend easily. It can also describe a person who is not relaxed or friendly.

words.ex: They believed there was a conspiracy to hide the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他们相信有人密谋隐瞒真相。
words.en: A conspiracy is a secret plan by a group of people to do something harmful or illegal.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The farmer works hard to sustain his crops.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民努力维持他的庄稼。
words.en: To sustain something means to continue it or maintain it for a period of time.

words.ex: The meek boy quietly listened to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 那个温顺的男孩静静地听老师讲课。
words.en: If you describe a person as meek, you think that they are gentle and quiet, and likely to do what other people say.

words.ex: The volcano had a big eruption last week.
words.ex_cn: 上周这座火山发生了大喷发。
words.en: An eruption is a sudden, often violent, outburst or discharge, such as that of a volcano, emotion, or conflict.

words.ex: Honesty is an inherent quality of a good leader.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是好领导固有的品质。
words.en: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.

words.tr: v. 发现；找到；建立；认为；“find”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He found a strange stone on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一块奇怪的石头。
words.en: To establish or set up (an organization, institution, or place) on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.tr: n. 省略号；省略；省略符号
words.ex: He used an ellipsis to show he stopped talking.
words.ex_cn: 他用了省略号来表示他停止了说话。
words.en: An ellipsis is a set of three dots (...) used in writing to indicate an omission of words or a pause.

words.ex: The child ripped the paper with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用手把纸撕裂了。
words.en: To rip something means to tear it quickly and forcefully.

words.ex: He enquired about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了火车时刻表。
words.en: If you enquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.tr: adj. 增补性的；补充性的；
words.ex: The teacher gave supplementary notes for the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师为这节课提供了增补性的笔记。
words.en: Supplementary things are added to something in order to improve it or make it more complete.

words.tr:
n. （长篇）小说；
adj. 新颖的；新奇的；
words.ex: He wrote a novel about a brave girl.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一部关于一个勇敢女孩的小说。
words.en: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

words.ex: Children have reliance on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子依赖父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: Reliance is the state of depending on or trusting in someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: He gave a contemptuous smile when she spoke.
words.ex_cn: 当她说话时，他露出轻蔑的微笑。
words.en: If you are contemptuous of someone or something, you do not like or respect them at all.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: The baron owns a large castle in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 男爵拥有一座位于乡村的大城堡。
words.en: A baron is a man who is a member of the lowest rank of the nobility, or a powerful businessman with great influence in a particular industry.

words.ex: The factory buys lumber to make furniture.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂购买木材来制造家具。
words.en: Lumber refers to wood that has been processed into beams and planks, a stage in the process of wood production. It is also used to describe the action of moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.

words.tr:
n. 闪光；闪烁；活力
v. 闪光；焕发活力
words.ex: The diamond showed a tiny sparkle in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 钻石在阳光下显示出一丝闪光。
words.en: If something sparkles, it shines brightly with a lot of small points of light.

words.ex: The remnant of the old wall still stands.
words.ex_cn: 这堵旧墙的残余部分仍然矗立着。
words.en: A remnant is a small remaining quantity of something.

words.ex: He hurt his rib when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了肋骨。
words.en: A rib is one of the long curved bones that are connected to the spine and surround the chest.

words.ex: He made a proposal to improve the school lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个改善学校午餐的提案。
words.en: A proposal is a plan or suggestion, especially a formal one that is put forward for people to think about and decide upon.

words.ex: The doctor used medical terminology to explain the illness.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用医学术语来解释这种疾病。
words.en: The set of terms and expressions used in a particular subject, field, or profession.

words.ex: He believed his destiny was to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他相信自己的命运是成为一名医生。
words.en: Destiny is the force which some people believe controls the things that happen to you in your life.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.ex: The alternation of day and night is natural.
words.ex_cn: 昼夜的交替是自然的。
words.en: The act or process of alternating; a successive change or variation.

words.ex: The pine grows tall in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 松树在森林里长得很高。
words.en: A pine is a type of evergreen tree which has long thin leaves called needles and produces cones. As a verb, to pine means to feel a deep longing or desire for something or someone.

words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr:
v. 拖；拉；拖运；
n. 拖；拉；拖运；
words.ex: He hauled the heavy box across the room.
words.ex_cn: 他把沉重的箱子拖过了房间。
words.en: To haul something means to pull it or carry it with a lot of effort.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.ex: He edits the school newspaper every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周编辑校报。
words.en: To prepare written material for publication by correcting, condensing, or otherwise modifying it.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.tr:
n. 模具；霉；
v. 铸造；
words.ex: The clay was poured into the mould to shape the pot.
words.ex_cn: 将黏土倒入模具中以塑造花盆。
words.en: A mould is a hollow container that you pour a liquid or soft substance into, which then becomes solid in the same shape as the container. Mould can also refer to a fungus that grows on old food or on damp surfaces.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.tr: v. 租借；出租；“rend”的过去式和过去分词； n. 租金；
words.ex: They rent a small apartment in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们租了一间城市里的小公寓。
words.en: Rent refers to the payment made periodically by a tenant to a landlord for the use of property or land.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the dock at sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 船在日出时到达了码头。
words.en: A dock is an enclosed area of water in a port where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.tr: n. 版画； v. 在（硬物）上雕刻；“engrave”的现在分词；
words.ex: He bought an old engraving at the art market.
words.ex_cn: 他在艺术市场买了一幅古老的版画。
words.en: An engraving is a picture or design that has been cut into a surface.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.tr: v. 断言；宣称；坚持；维护
words.ex: He asserts that the answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 他坚持认为答案是正确的。
words.en: To state a fact or belief confidently and forcefully.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr:
n. 运输；
v. 运输；
words.ex: He uses public transport to go to work.
words.ex_cn: 他乘坐公共交通去上班。
words.en: To transport something or someone is to move them from one place to another, especially over long distances.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: He grabbed the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速抓住了球。
words.en: If you grab something, you take it or pick it up suddenly and roughly.

words.tr: adj. （言行）谨慎的；不显眼的；朴素的
words.ex: He was discreet about his personal life.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的私生活很低调。
words.en: If you are discreet, you are polite and careful in what you do or say, because you want to avoid embarrassing or offending someone.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.ex: He steers the team toward success.
words.ex_cn: 他引导团队走向成功。
words.en: To steer a vehicle, ship, or aircraft is to control its direction.

words.tr: adj. 沉闷乏味的；忧郁的；凄凉的
words.ex: The weather was dreary and rainy all day.
words.ex_cn: 天气一整天都阴沉沉的，还下着雨。
words.en: If you describe something as dreary, you mean that it is dull, lifeless, or depressing.

words.tr:
adj. 待定的；即将发生的
prep. 在等待…期间；直到…为止
words.ex: The decision is pending.
words.ex_cn: 决定尚未做出。
words.en: If something is pending, it has not yet happened or been decided, and is often waiting for something else to happen first.

words.ex: The sophistication of the machine allows it to work very precisely.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器的精密使其能够非常精确地工作。
words.en: Sophistication refers to the quality of being sophisticated, which includes complexity, refinement, and worldly experience.

words.ex: Salt water causes corrosion on metal.
words.ex_cn: 盐水会导致金属腐蚀。
words.en: Corrosion is the process in which a metal is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction, usually with oxygen or water.

words.tr: v. 弥补；兑换；付清；赎回；履行
words.ex: He worked hard to redeem his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作来弥补自己的错误。
words.en: To redeem something means to get it back by paying a sum of money or by doing something to compensate for a fault or mistake.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.tr:
n. 懦夫；胆小鬼；胆怯者
adj. 胆小的；怯懦的
words.ex: He was a coward and ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他是个懦夫，逃跑了。
words.en: A coward is someone who is easily frightened and avoids dangerous or difficult situations.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: The outcome of the game was a tie.
words.ex_cn: 比赛的结果是平局。
words.en: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

words.ex: This brand has an exclusive design.
words.ex_cn: 这个品牌拥有独有的设计。
words.en: Something that is exclusive is available only to particular people, and not to everyone.

words.tr: v. 使屈辱；使丢脸；使蒙羞
words.ex: He tried to humiliate her in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在全班面前羞辱她。
words.en: To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed or stupid, especially in front of other people.

words.tr:
n. 殉道者；殉教者；烈士
v. 处死；折磨
words.ex: He became a martyr for freedom.
words.ex_cn: 他为自由而成为烈士。
words.en: A martyr is someone who is killed or made to suffer greatly because of their religious or political beliefs, and is admired and respected by people who share those beliefs.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a handbook for the science project.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们发了一本科学项目的手册。
words.en: A handbook is a type of reference work, or other collection of instructions, that is intended to provide ready reference.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.tr: adj. 未加工处理过的；生的；
words.ex: He eats raw vegetables every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃未加工的蔬菜。
words.en: Raw refers to something that is in its natural state and not processed or cooked.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.ex: His utterance made everyone silent.
words.ex_cn: 他的话让所有人都沉默了。
words.en: An utterance is a word, statement, or sound that someone says.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: The sponge lives in the ocean and filters water for food.
words.ex_cn: 这种海绵动物生活在海洋中，通过过滤水来获取食物。
words.en: A sponge is a piece of a soft, light, porous substance originally from the skeletons of marine creatures, used for washing, cleaning, or padding. As a verb, it means to wipe, rub, or clean with a sponge or to absorb something.

words.ex: The bottle has a cork stopper.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子有一个软木塞。
words.en: Cork is a light, porous material obtained from the bark of the cork oak tree, used especially for making stoppers for bottles.

words.ex: The road inclines sharply to the top of the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这条路陡峭地倾斜向山顶。
words.en: If you incline to a particular opinion, you have a tendency to think or behave in a particular way.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.tr: v. 使迷惑；使...不知所措
words.ex: The strange signs bewilder the children.
words.ex_cn: 这些奇怪的符号让孩子们感到迷惑。
words.en: If something bewilders you, it is so confusing or difficult that you cannot understand it.

words.ex: The agency helps people find jobs.
words.ex_cn: 这个机构帮助人们找工作。
words.en: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: The bank recorded the transaction quickly.
words.ex_cn: 银行迅速记录了这笔交易。
words.en: A transaction is an instance of buying or selling something; a business deal.

words.tr:
v. 奔驰；飞奔
n. 奔驰；飞奔
words.ex: The horse gallops across the field.
words.ex_cn: 马在田野上疾驰。
words.en: If a horse gallops, it runs very fast so that all four legs are off the ground at the same time in each stride.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fort during the battle.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在战斗中保卫了堡垒。
words.en: A fort is a strong building or a place with a wall or fence around it where soldiers can stay and be safe from the enemy.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.tr: adj. 渴望的；热心的；敏锐的；
words.ex: He is keen to learn English.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望学习英语。
words.en: If you are keen on doing something, you very much want to do it. If you are keen that something should happen, you very much want it to happen.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.ex: The accident was a serious incident.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是一起严重事件。
words.en: An incident is an event that is either unpleasant or unusual.

words.tr:
n. 首都；财富；大写字母；
adj. 大写的；
words.ex: Beijing is the capital of China.
words.ex_cn: 北京是中国的首都。
words.en: The city or town that functions as the seat of government and administrative center of a country or region.

words.tr: adj. 不顾一切的；极度渴望的；绝望的；
words.ex: He made a desperate attempt to save the child.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾一切地试图救那个孩子。
words.en: If you are desperate, you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to try anything to change it.

words.tr: v. 发芽；长出；迅速成长；涌现；
words.ex: The seed will sprout in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这颗种子会在春天发芽。
words.en: If a plant sprouts, or if it sprouts something, it produces new leaves or buds.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 元帅；高级军官；典礼官；消防局长
v. 整理；集结
words.ex: The marshal led the army into battle.
words.ex_cn: 元帅率领军队上战场。
words.en: A marshal is a high-ranking officer in the armed forces, especially in the army or air force, or a person who arranges or directs a public event.

words.tr: n. 四轮运货马车；敞篷货车；
words.ex: The farmer used a wooden wagon to carry crops.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用一辆木制四轮运货马车运送庄稼。
words.en: A wagon is a vehicle with four wheels, usually pulled by horses or oxen, used for transporting goods.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.ex: He showed his disapproval by staying silent.
words.ex_cn: 他通过保持沉默表示反对。
words.en: Disapproval is the feeling that someone or something is bad, wrong, or unacceptable.

words.ex: The flowers wither in the hot sun.
words.ex_cn: 花朵在烈日下枯萎。
words.en: If a plant withers, it dries up and dies. If something withers, it becomes weaker or less important until it disappears completely.

words.tr: adj. 全世界的；四海一家的；
words.ex: This city has a cosmopolitan population.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市有着来自世界各地的人口。
words.en: A cosmopolitan place or society is full of people from many different countries and cultures.

words.ex: The company will withhold his salary until he signs the contract.
words.ex_cn: 公司会扣留他的工资，直到他签署合同。
words.en: If you withhold something that someone wants, you refuse to let them have it.

words.tr: adj. 脆弱的；易碎的；不牢固的；
words.ex: The glass is fragile and might break easily.
words.ex_cn: 这个玻璃很脆弱，容易碎。
words.en: If something is fragile, it is easily broken or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 利润；
v. 获利；
words.ex: The company made a big profit this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年赚了大量利润。
words.en: Profit is the amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

words.ex: The installation of the new machine took two days.
words.ex_cn: 新机器的安置花了两天时间。
words.en: The act of installing or the state of being installed.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.tr: v. 象征；代表；用符号表示
words.ex: The dove symbolizes peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子象征和平。
words.en: If one thing symbolizes another, it is used or regarded as a symbol of it.

words.ex: The proceeds from the sale went to charity.
words.ex_cn: 销售所得收益捐给了慈善机构。
words.en: Proceeds are the money that is received from a particular event or activity, especially when it is used for a specific purpose.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.tr:
n. 群；团；簇；
v. 聚集；
words.ex: The stars form a bright cluster in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星在夜空中形成了一群明亮的星群。
words.en: A cluster of things or people is a small group of them close together.

words.ex: The colonel gave orders to the soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 上校向士兵下达了命令。
words.en: A colonel is a senior officer in the army, air force, or marines, ranking above a lieutenant colonel and below a brigadier or brigadier general.

words.ex: The commander gave the order to advance.
words.ex_cn: 指挥官下达了前进的命令。
words.en: A commander is a person in authority, especially in the armed forces, who gives orders and is responsible for the actions of those under their command.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
n. 哀悼；悲痛；服丧
v. 悼念；哀痛；“mourn”的现在分词
words.ex: He is mourning the loss of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为失去他的狗而哀悼。
words.en: Mourning is the expression of deep sorrow for someone who has died, typically involving following certain conventions such as wearing black clothes.

words.ex: The table is made of sturdy wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用坚固的木头做的。
words.en: Someone or something that is sturdy looks strong and is unlikely to be easily injured or damaged.

words.tr:
n. 金额；总数；
v. 概括；
words.ex: The sum of the bill is fifty dollars.
words.ex_cn: 账单的金额是五十美元。
words.en: A sum is an amount of money, or the total amount of two or more amounts of money added together.

words.tr: adj. 光亮的；闪耀的；锃亮的；有光泽的；
words.ex: The shiny coin caught her eye.
words.ex_cn: 那枚光亮的硬币引起了她的注意。
words.en: Something that is shiny has a bright, smooth surface that reflects light.

words.ex: He had a realization that he needed to change his life.
words.ex_cn: 他领悟到自己需要改变生活。
words.en: The act of becoming fully aware of something as a fact; the achievement of something desired or anticipated.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.ex: He lingered by the door, not wanting to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他逗留在门口，不想离开。
words.en: If you linger somewhere, you stay there for a longer time than is necessary, for example because you are enjoying yourself.

words.ex: The number of apples corresponds to the number of oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的数量与橙子的数量相对应。
words.en: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them, often because one is the cause or the result of the other.

words.ex: His handwriting is illegible.
words.ex_cn: 他的字迹无法辨认。
words.en: If something is illegible, it is impossible to read because the letters or characters are not clear, are not formed properly, or are obscured in some way.

words.tr: adj. 攻击性的；有进取心的；侵略性的；
words.ex: The dog showed aggressive behavior toward strangers.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗对陌生人表现出攻击性行为。
words.en: An aggressive person or animal has a quality of anger and determination that makes them ready to attack others.

words.ex: The teacher gave a satisfactory grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个令人满意的分数。
words.en: If something is satisfactory, it is good enough or acceptable.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.tr: adj. 分析的；善于分析的；
words.ex: He uses analytical skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用分析能力解决数学问题。
words.en: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.tr: v. 处置；清除；解决；“dispose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理掉了那些旧书。
words.en: If you are disposed to do something, you are willing or eager to do it.

words.tr:
n. 种类；类别；
v. 理清；解决；把…分类；拣选；
words.ex: This store sells all sorts of fruits.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。
words.en: A sort is a kind or category of things or people which have similar characteristics.

words.ex: He bought a bottle of liquor for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他为派对买了一瓶酒。
words.en: Liquor is an alcoholic drink that is made by distillation rather than by fermentation.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: The ship dropped its anchor in the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船在港口放下了锚。
words.en: An anchor is a heavy object that is dropped from a boat or a ship into the water to prevent the vessel from moving.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.ex: The radar shows a plane coming near.
words.ex_cn: 雷达显示一架飞机正在靠近。
words.en: A system for detecting the presence, direction, distance, and speed of aircraft, ships, and other objects, by sending out pulses of radio waves which are reflected off the object back to the source.

words.tr:
v. 使滞留；使搁浅；
n. 方面；
words.ex: The storm stranded the travelers on the island.
words.ex_cn: 风暴使旅行者滞留在岛上。
words.en: If someone is stranded, they are left in a place that is difficult for them to get away from. A strand of something such as hair, wire, or thread is a single thin piece of it.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；呼啸；抱怨
n. 呻吟声；萧萧声；抱怨
words.ex: He moans when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候会呻吟。
words.en: If you moan, you make a low sound, usually because you are unhappy or in pain.

words.ex: The police scotched the plan to rob the bank.
words.ex_cn: 警察阻止了抢劫银行的计划。
words.en: To scotch something means to stop it from continuing or developing.

words.ex: The infantry marched through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 步兵穿过森林行进。
words.en: Infantry refers to soldiers who fight on foot, especially in contrast to cavalry or artillery.

words.ex: He is virtually always on time.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是准时。
words.en: In effect though not formally recognized; practically.

words.tr:
n. 圆；圈；
v. 圈出；环绕；
words.ex: The child drew a circle with a pen.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用笔画了一个圆。
words.en: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

words.tr: v. 买得起；担负得起；有时间做；
words.ex: I can't afford a new car.
words.ex_cn: 我买不起一辆新车。
words.en: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.tr: adj. 有声望的；声誉好的
words.ex: He works for a reputable company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家信誉良好的公司工作。
words.en: A reputable person or organization is considered to be good and trustworthy by most people.

words.ex: His rude comment was a provocation to start a fight.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的评论是一种挑衅，想引发争斗。
words.en: If you describe someone's action as a provocation, you mean that it is likely to cause a reaction or argument, especially a violent or angry one.

words.ex: The table has an oval shape.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是椭圆形的。
words.en: An oval is a shape that is like a circle but is longer in one direction than the other.

words.ex: He said it with sarcasm, even though he seemed happy.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话时带着讽刺，尽管他看起来很高兴。
words.en: Sarcasm is a sharp, bitter, or cutting expression or remark; a bitter gibe or taunt.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr:
n. 凡人
adj. 致命的；终有一死的
words.ex: All mortal beings must die someday.
words.ex_cn: 所有凡人都终有一死。
words.en: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live forever.

words.tr: v. 使声音降低；压抑（声音）；蒙住；裹
words.ex: He muffled his laugh with a pillow.
words.ex_cn: 他用枕头捂住笑声。
words.en: To muffle a sound is to make it quieter or less clear, often by covering it or wrapping it in something.

words.tr:
adj. 智力的；
n. 知识分子；
words.ex: He is an intellectual person who loves solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个热爱解决数学问题的智力型人。
words.en: An intellectual is someone who spends a lot of time studying and thinking about complicated ideas.

words.tr: adj. 多方面的；有多种技能的；
words.ex: He is a versatile player who can play many positions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名多方面的运动员，能打多个位置。
words.en: Able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities.

words.tr: adj. 虔诚的；信神的；伪善的
words.ex: He is a pious man who prays every day.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个每天祈祷的虔诚的人。
words.en: Someone who is pious is very religious and moral.

words.ex: The width of the table is one meter.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的宽度是一米。
words.en: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side to the other.

words.tr: adj. 憔悴的；形容枯槁的
words.ex: He looked haggard after working all night.
words.ex_cn: 他熬了一整夜后看起来憔悴不堪。
words.en: Someone who is haggard looks exhausted and unwell, often because they have been through a very difficult or stressful experience.

words.ex: This district has many parks and schools.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有许多公园和学校。
words.en: A district is a part of a city, country, or other area that has been officially designated for a particular purpose, such as administration or business.

words.ex: He works in financial planning.
words.ex_cn: 他从事财政规划工作。
words.en: Relating to finance or the management of large amounts of money.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.tr:
n. 日期；年代；约会；枣子；枣椰树；
v. 标日期；约会；追溯到；过时；
words.ex: What is the date today?
words.ex_cn: 今天是几号？
words.en: A date is a specific day of the month or year, which can be identified by a particular name or number.

words.ex: The manager will authorize the payment tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 经理明天将批准这笔付款。
words.en: To give official permission for something to happen, or to give someone official permission to do something.

words.ex: The technician fixed the broken machine.
words.ex_cn: 技术员修好了坏掉的机器。
words.en: A technician is a worker trained with special skills, especially in science or engineering.

words.tr: adj. 首创性的；先驱性的； v. “pioneer”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a pioneering discovery in renewable energy.
words.ex_cn: 他在可再生能源领域做出了开创性的发现。
words.en: Involving new ideas or methods, and being the first to use them in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 神龛；神社；圣地；圣殿
words.ex: People visit the shrine to pray.
words.ex_cn: 人们去神社祈祷。
words.en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

words.ex: He peruses the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上浏览报纸。
words.en: To read or examine something carefully or thoroughly.

words.ex: The court will prosecute him for theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院将因盗窃罪起诉他。
words.en: To prosecute means to institute legal proceedings against someone or to carry on a legal action against a defendant in a court of law. It also means to continue with or carry on an activity or enterprise.

words.ex: He used an abbreviation for 'company' in his note.
words.ex_cn: 他在笔记中用了'company'的缩写。
words.en: An abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase.

words.tr: adj. 亲切的；和蔼的；仁慈的
words.ex: She was gracious and thanked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 她很友善，感谢了每一个人。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially someone you think is superior to you, as gracious, you mean that they are very well-mannered and pleasant.

words.ex: They made a concerted effort to clean the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们共同努力清理了公园。
words.en: A concerted action or effort is done by several people or groups working together.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.ex: He used a voucher to buy a coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张代金券买了一杯咖啡。
words.en: A voucher is a piece of paper that can be used instead of money to pay for something, or that allows you to pay less than the usual price for something.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: The law is retroactive and covers last year.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律具有追溯效力，适用于去年。
words.en: If a decision, action, or law is retroactive, it is intended to take effect from a date before it was actually made.

words.ex: The crowd fell into hysteria when the fire alarm sounded.
words.ex_cn: 当火警响起时，人群陷入了情绪失控。
words.en: Hysteria is a state of extreme excitement, fear, or anger in which people cannot control their emotions or behavior.

words.tr:
n. 最高统治者；君主；元首
adj. 独立自主的；拥有最高统治权的
words.ex: The sovereign makes important decisions for the country.
words.ex_cn: 君主为国家做出重要决定。
words.en: A sovereign is a king, queen, or other supreme ruler.

words.ex: The violent storm destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场暴力的风暴摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: If someone is violent, or if they do something that is violent, they use physical force or weapons to hurt, injure, or kill other people.

words.tr: adj. 忠实的；虔诚的；可靠的；
words.ex: He is a faithful friend who always helps me.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个总是帮助我的忠实朋友。
words.en: Someone who is faithful remains loyal to a person, belief, or cause, and continues to support them.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr: adj. 比喻的；象征的；写实的
words.ex: He used figurative language to describe his feelings.
words.ex_cn: 他用了比喻性的语言来描述他的感受。
words.en: If you use a word or expression in a figurative sense, you use it with a more abstract or imaginative meaning than its ordinary literal one.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.ex: The two shirts are identical.
words.ex_cn: 这两件衬衫是一样的。
words.en: Exactly the same, or very similar.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: The company agreed to defray the travel expenses.
words.ex_cn: 公司同意支付差旅费。
words.en: If you defray someone's costs or expenses, you give them money which represents the amount that they have spent, for example while they have been doing something for you or acting on your behalf.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.ex: The keyboard is a peripheral device.
words.ex_cn: 键盘是一个外围设备。
words.en: A peripheral activity or issue is one that is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.ex: The cake has three layers of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕有三层巧克力。
words.en: A layer of a substance or material is a quantity or piece of it that covers a surface or that is between two other things.

words.tr: v. 调整；使适合；使适应；
words.ex: He adjusted the chair to sit comfortably.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了椅子以便坐得舒服。
words.en: To adjust something means to change it so that it is more effective or appropriate, or so that it fits better.

words.ex: He writes simple prose every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写简单的散文。
words.en: Prose is written language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure.

words.tr: v. 代表；表现；体现；相当于；
words.ex: He represents his country in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中代表他的国家。
words.en: If someone represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

words.ex: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.en: Milk is a white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use in cooking.

words.ex: My mom scolded me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而责备了我。
words.en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: He faced imprisonment for stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷钱而面临监禁。
words.en: The state of being confined in prison; the act of putting someone in prison or the condition of being kept in prison.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.tr: n. 律师；辩护律师；代理人
words.ex: The attorney helped the man with his case.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助那个人处理了他的案件。
words.en: An attorney is a lawyer who is qualified to represent a client in court.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: The Earth is a globe.
words.ex_cn: 地球是一个球体。
words.en: The globe is the world; especially used to refer to the Earth as a planet.

words.ex: The terrorists hijacked a plane and flew it to another country.
words.ex_cn: 恐怖分子劫持了一架飞机，飞到了另一个国家。
words.en: To hijack a vehicle or aircraft is to take control of it by force, often in order to steal it or to use it for a purpose other than its intended one.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.tr: adj. 教育性的；有启发的；有益的
words.ex: The movie is instructive for children.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影对孩子们很有教育意义。
words.en: Providing useful or interesting information or knowledge.

words.tr: n. 交会处；十字路口； v. 穿过；“cross”的现在分词；
words.ex: Be careful at the crossing near the school.
words.ex_cn: 在学校附近的交会处要小心。
words.en: A crossing is a place where something such as a road, river, or railway can be crossed safely.

words.ex: The red hat was conspicuous in the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 那顶红帽子在人群中非常显眼。
words.en: Something that is conspicuous is very obvious or easy to notice.

words.tr:
n. 回声；
v. 回响；
words.ex: The echo came back from the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 回声从山上反弹回来。
words.en: An echo is a sound which is caused by a noise being reflected off a surface such as a wall.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.ex: The fallen tree was an obstruction on the road.
words.ex_cn: 倒下的树是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstruction is something that blocks a road, passage, or entrance, or the act of blocking something.

words.ex: He drag the box across the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子拖过地板。
words.en: To pull something along the ground, often with difficulty or effort.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；叹息
n. 呻吟声；叹息声
words.ex: He groaned when he saw the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那个沉重的箱子时呻吟了一声。
words.en: If you groan, you make a long, low sound because you are in pain, or because you are upset or unhappy about something.

words.ex: He likes reading, and furthermore, he writes stories too.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢阅读，而且他还写故事。
words.en: In addition to what has been said; moreover.

words.ex: He ate jelly with bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃面包配果冻。
words.en: A sweet, clear, semisolid, somewhat elastic spread or dessert made from fruit syrup and pectin or gelatin.

words.ex: He left school at 15, which was too premature.
words.ex_cn: 他15岁就离开了学校，这太早了。
words.en: Happening or done before the usual or expected time; not fully developed or mature.

words.tr:
n. 攻击；袭击；
v. 攻击；袭击；
words.ex: The attack happened at night.
words.ex_cn: 这次攻击发生在夜晚。
words.en: To attack means to try to hurt or defeat someone or something by using force or violence.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: The teacher gave me feedback on my essay.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我关于我作文的反馈。
words.en: Feedback is comments in the form of opinions about and reactions to something, intended to provide useful information for future decisions and development.

words.ex: The surgeon fixed the broken bone.
words.ex_cn: 外科医生修复了断裂的骨头。
words.en: A surgeon is a medical doctor who performs operations.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: He uses disinfectant to clean the bathroom.
words.ex_cn: 他用消毒剂清洁浴室。
words.en: A disinfectant is a chemical substance that is used to kill harmful bacteria and viruses.

words.tr:
v. 粘附；（随意）放置；忍受；
n. 棍枝；条状物；球棍；
words.ex: The glue makes the paper stick to the table.
words.ex_cn: 胶水使纸粘在桌子上。
words.en: A stick is a thin branch which has fallen off a tree. If you stick something somewhere, you put it there in a rather casual way.

words.ex: He missed three consecutive days of school.
words.ex_cn: 他连续三天没上学。
words.en: Consecutive events, numbers, etc. follow one after another without an interruption.

words.ex: He always follows the principle of honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他总是遵循诚实的原则。
words.en: A principle is a basic idea or rule that explains or controls how something happens or works.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.ex: He bought a new mirror because of his vanity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为虚荣心买了一面新镜子。
words.en: The quality of being vain; excessive pride in or admiration of one's own appearance or achievements.

words.ex: She bakes bread every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 她每周日都烤面包。
words.en: To bake is to cook food using dry heat, especially in an oven.

words.ex: The warrior fought bravely to protect his village.
words.ex_cn: 这位战士勇敢地战斗以保护他的村庄。
words.en: A warrior is a person who is engaged in or experienced in battle, or who shows or has shown great vigor, courage, or aggressiveness, as in politics or athletics.

words.ex: He modulates his voice to sound calm.
words.ex_cn: 他调节自己的声音以显得平静。
words.en: To modulate means to change or adjust something, such as your voice or a piece of equipment, to achieve a desired effect or to make it suitable for a particular situation.

words.ex: They want to immigrate to Canada for a better life.
words.ex_cn: 他们想移民到加拿大过更好的生活。
words.en: To come to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.tr:
n. 刹车；制动器
v. 刹车
words.ex: He pressed the brake to stop the car.
words.ex_cn: 他踩了刹车来停车。
words.en: A brake is a device in a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop.

words.tr:
n. 公司；商行；
adj. 坚固的；结实的；
words.ex: He works for a small firm in London.
words.ex_cn: 他在伦敦一家小公司工作。
words.en: If something is firm, it does not change much in shape when it is pressed but is not completely hard. A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

words.ex: He hastened to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他赶紧在晚饭前写完作业。
words.en: If you hasten to do something, you quickly do it or quickly go somewhere.

words.ex: She implored him to stay.
words.ex_cn: 她恳求他留下。
words.en: If you implore someone to do something, you ask them to do it in a forceful, emotional way.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.ex: The country made a declaration of independence.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家发表了独立宣言。
words.en: A declaration is a formal statement or announcement.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr: n. 紫外线辐射；紫外光；
words.ex: The ultraviolet from the sun can hurt your skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的紫外线会伤害你的皮肤。
words.en: Ultraviolet light or radiation has a wavelength shorter than that of visible light but longer than X-rays.

words.ex: He reverted to his old habits after the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 假期后，他恢复了旧习惯。
words.en: To return to a former state, practice, topic, etc.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.ex: The birds sing at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黎明时歌唱。
words.en: The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise; the beginning of a phenomenon or period of time.

words.ex: The cat made an instinctive jump to avoid the dog.
words.ex_cn: 猫本能地跳开以躲避狗。
words.en: An instinctive feeling, action, or idea is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

words.ex: My son loves watching cartoon animation.
words.ex_cn: 我儿子喜欢看卡通动画。
words.en: Animation is the process of making films in which drawings or puppets appear to move.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: He wore an outlandish hat to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇异的帽子去参加派对。
