words.ex_cn: 他把衣服装进了行李箱。
words.en: A suitcase is a case with a handle and often with wheels, used for carrying clothes and possessions when travelling.

words.ex: There was a thin mist over the lake at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，湖面上有一层薄雾。
words.en: Mist is a thin layer of cloud that touches the ground. It is less dense than fog and can make it difficult to see clearly.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.tr:
v. 皱眉；蹙额
n. 皱眉；蹙额
words.ex: He frowns when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到坏消息时会皱眉。
words.en: If you frown, you bring your eyebrows together so that there are lines on your face above your eyes, often because you are annoyed or worried.

words.tr: adj. 引起恐惧的；使惊恐的；骇人的； v. “frighten”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark forest looked frightening at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来很吓人。
words.en: If you say that something is frightening, you mean that it makes you feel afraid or anxious.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: The occurrence of rain surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 下雨这件事让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An occurrence is something that happens or takes place.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.ex: The truck suffered an overload and broke down.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车因超载而抛锚了。
words.en: To load or burden someone or something excessively.

words.ex: He reads books in his leisure.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: Leisure is the time when you are not working and you can relax and do things that you enjoy.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: He felt great distress when he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 当他失去工作时，他感到非常忧虑。
words.en: Distress is a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.ex: It is advisable to wear a helmet when riding a bike.
words.ex_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是明智的。
words.en: If something is advisable, it will avoid problems if you do it.

words.ex: The river forms the border between the two countries.
words.ex_cn: 这条河是两个国家的边界。
words.en: The edge or boundary of something, or the part near it; a dividing line.

words.ex: He has great proficiency in English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: If you show proficiency in something, you show ability or skill at it.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.tr:
v. 耗尽；用完；使筋疲力尽
n. 排气管；废气
words.ex: The long hike exhausted him.
words.ex_cn: 这次漫长的徒步旅行让他筋疲力尽。
words.en: If something exhausts you, it makes you so tired, either physically or mentally, that you have no energy left.

words.tr: adj. 杰出的；尚未处理的；
words.ex: He is an outstanding student who always gets top grades.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名杰出的学生，总是取得最高分。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as outstanding, you think that they are very remarkable and impressive.

words.ex: She readily agreed to help me.
words.ex_cn: 她很容易就同意帮我了。
words.en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: He staggered home after drinking too much.
words.ex_cn: 他喝多了后摇摇晃晃地走回家。
words.en: If you stagger, you walk very unsteadily, as if you are about to fall.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.tr:
n. 英寻（长度单位）
v. 测深；推测；揣摩；搞懂；彻底了解
words.ex: The ship's anchor sank to a depth of ten fathoms.
words.ex_cn: 船的锚沉到了十英寻的深度。
words.en: If you cannot fathom something, you are unable to understand it, although you think carefully about it.

words.tr: v. 由于保险丝烧断而电路不通；熔接；结合；
words.ex: The light went out because the fuse blew.
words.ex_cn: 灯灭了，因为保险丝烧断了。
words.en: A fuse is a safety device consisting of a strip of wire that melts and breaks an electric circuit if the current exceeds a safe level. As a verb, it means to join or blend to form a single entity.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.ex: I feel sympathy for the poor children.
words.ex_cn: 我对那些可怜的孩子感到同情。
words.en: If you have sympathy for someone who is in a bad situation, you are sorry for them, and show this in the way you behave towards them.

words.ex: He has a delusion that he is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种错觉，认为自己是一位著名歌手。
words.en: A delusion is a belief or impression that is firmly maintained despite being contradicted by what is generally accepted as reality or rational argument, typically a symptom of mental disorder.

words.ex: He asked for a quotation for the new computer.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了新电脑的报价。
words.en: A quotation is a sentence or phrase taken from a book, poem, play, etc., which is repeated by someone else, or a statement of the current price of something.

words.ex: He is the backbone of the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是团队的中坚。
words.en: The backbone is the most important part of something, providing support and strength.

words.ex: The temperature increases by one increment every hour.
words.ex_cn: 温度每小时增加一个单位。
words.en: An increment is an amount by which something increases or is increased.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.tr:
n. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
v. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
words.ex: The soldier gave a salute to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向军官敬礼。
words.en: If you salute someone, you greet them or show your respect with a formal sign. Soldiers usually salute officers by raising their right hand so that their fingers touch their forehead.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr:
n. 纽带；联系；债券；保释金；协定
v. （使）黏合；相互联结
words.ex: Family is the bond that keeps us together.
words.ex_cn: 家庭是我们团结的纽带。
words.en: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

words.ex: The king's assassination shocked the whole country.
words.ex_cn: 国王的暗杀震惊了整个国家。
words.en: The act of killing someone important or famous, often for political reasons.

words.tr: n. 扩展；延长期；延伸；电话分机；
words.ex: The company added an extension to its office building.
words.ex_cn: 公司为办公楼加了一个扩建部分。
words.en: An extension is a part that is added to something to make it longer or larger, or the act of adding this part.

words.tr:
n. 厄运；毁灭；死亡
v. 注定；判决
words.ex: The old prophecy spoke of doom for the kingdom.
words.ex_cn: 古老的预言说这个王国将遭遇厄运。
words.en: Doom is a terrible fate or destiny that you cannot avoid, especially death or destruction.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.tr: adj. 最外面的；（离中心）最远的
words.ex: The outermost layer of the onion is brown.
words.ex_cn: 洋葱最外层是棕色的。
words.en: situated at the farthest possible point from the center

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr:
v. 跛行；蹒跚；瘸着走
adj. 无力的；无生气的
words.ex: He limps after hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路一瘸一拐。
words.en: If someone limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

words.ex: The big company owns a subsidiary that makes phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家大公司拥有一家生产手机的附属公司。
words.en: A subsidiary is a company which is part of a larger and more important company.

words.tr: v. 驱散；消散；浪费；挥霍
words.ex: The fog will dissipate by noon.
words.ex_cn: 雾将在中午前消散。
words.en: If something dissipates or is dissipated, it becomes less or becomes less strong until it disappears or goes away completely.

words.ex: Initially, he didn't like the job.
words.ex_cn: 最初，他不喜欢这份工作。
words.en: At the beginning; at first.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: Ancient warfare used swords and shields.
words.ex_cn: 古代战争使用剑和盾。
words.en: Warfare is the activity of fighting a war.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.tr:
n. 发票；发货单；
v. 开发票；记清单；
words.ex: He paid the bill after receiving the invoice.
words.ex_cn: 他收到发票后付了款。
words.en: An invoice is a document that lists goods or services that have been provided and says how much money you owe for them.

words.tr:
n. 输出；出口；
v. 输出；出口；
words.ex: This country is a big export of wheat.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家是小麦的大输出国。
words.en: To send goods to another country for sale.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.ex: The movie caused a feeling of terror in the audience.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影让观众感到恐怖。
words.en: Terror is a very strong feeling of fear, especially fear that you experience suddenly.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.tr: v. 委托；交付；托运；寄售
words.ex: He will consign the package to the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他将把包裹寄到邮局。
words.en: If you consign something to someone, you give it to them to keep or to sell.

words.ex: He studied hard, thereby passing the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，因此通过了考试。
words.en: You use thereby to introduce an important result or consequence of the event or action you have just mentioned.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: The weather prediction says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: A prediction is a statement about what you think will happen in the future.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The weaver makes beautiful cloth by hand.
words.ex_cn: 织布工手工制作美丽的布料。
words.en: A weaver is a person who weaves fabric or baskets.

words.ex: Smoking is a detriment to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that causes damage, harm, or loss.

words.tr:
n. 袋子；
v. 劫掠；
words.ex: He carried the apples in a burlap sack.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果装在一个麻布袋里。
words.en: A sack is a large bag made of rough woven material, used for storing or carrying goods. It can also refer to the act of dismissing someone from employment or the act of looting a place.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.tr:
n. 边；边缘；帽边
v. （装）满；（使）溢出
words.ex: The cup is full to the brim.
words.ex_cn: 杯子装得满满的。
words.en: The top edge of a container or the projecting edge of a hat.

words.tr: n. 小路；小巷；航道；车道；航线；
words.ex: The children walked down the narrow lane to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们沿着狭窄的小路去上学。
words.en: A lane is a narrow road, especially in the country. It can also refer to a division of a road intended to separate lines of traffic moving in the same or opposite directions.

words.tr:
n. 委员会；佣金；
v. 委托；
words.ex: The commission met to discuss the new law.
words.ex_cn: 委员会开会讨论新法律。
words.en: A commission is a group of people who have been appointed to find out about something or to control something, or the act of doing this. It can also refer to a sum of money that is paid to someone for selling something, which is usually a percentage of the value of the goods sold.

words.ex: The locomotive pulled the train down the track.
words.ex_cn: 机车拉着火车沿着轨道行驶。
words.en: A locomotive is a powered rail vehicle used for pulling trains.

words.ex: The small spider is harmless.
words.ex_cn: 这只小蜘蛛是无害的。
words.en: If someone or something is harmless, they are not dangerous and do not cause any harm.

words.tr:
n. 熏香；熏香的烟
v. 使愤怒；激怒
words.ex: The smell of incense fills the room.
words.ex_cn: 香火的气味充满了房间。
words.en: Incense is a substance that is burned for its pleasant smell, often used in religious ceremonies. As a verb, to incense means to make someone very angry.

words.ex: He felt ecstasy after winning the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得奖品后感到无比喜悦。
words.en: Ecstasy is a feeling of very great happiness.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.ex: The teacher will determine the winner of the contest.
words.ex_cn: 老师将确定比赛的获胜者。
words.en: If you determine something, you decide it or settle it.

words.ex: He remarked that the weather was nice.
words.ex_cn: 他评论说天气很好。
words.en: If you remark that something is the case, you say that it is the case.

words.ex: He decided to waive the fee.
words.ex_cn: 他决定放弃这笔费用。
words.en: If you waive a right, claim, or privilege, you do not insist on it or do not use it.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.ex: The budget is a constraint on our project.
words.ex_cn: 预算是我们项目的限制。
words.en: A constraint is something that limits or controls what you can do.

words.ex: The stars seem to go on to infinity.
words.ex_cn: 星星似乎延伸到无限。
words.en: Infinity is a concept of something that is unlimited, endless, without bound.

words.ex: He gave a bold speech in front of the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他在众人面前发表了大胆的演讲。
words.en: Someone who is bold is not afraid to do things which involve risk or danger.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.tr: v. 区分；“distinguish”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 卓越的；著名的；
words.ex: He distinguished the fake coin from the real one.
words.ex_cn: 他把假硬币和真硬币区分开来。
words.en: If you describe a person or their work as distinguished, you mean that they have been very successful in their career and have a good reputation.

words.tr: n. 检查；视察；查看；审视；
words.ex: The teacher did an inspection of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师对教室进行了检查。
words.en: An inspection is an official visit to a building or organization to check that everything is satisfactory and that rules are being obeyed.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: The teacher showed a chart of temperatures.
words.ex_cn: 老师展示了一张温度图表。
words.en: A chart is a graphical representation of data, in which the data is represented by symbols, such as bars in a bar chart, lines in a line chart, or slices in a pie chart.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.tr:
adv. 迷路地；误入歧途地
adj. 迷路的；误入歧途的
words.ex: The little dog went astray in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在公园里走丢了。
words.en: If you go astray, you lose your direction when you are trying to go somewhere.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: He resolved the problem with a simple plan.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个简单的计划解决了问题。
words.en: If you resolve to do something, you make a firm decision to do it.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.tr:
n. 曲柄杖；钩；弯曲处；骗子
v. （使）弯曲；使成钩状
words.ex: The old man walked with a wooden crook.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人拿着一根木制曲柄杖走路。
words.en: A crook is a person who is dishonest or a criminal, or it can refer to a bend or curve in something.

words.ex: He is doubtless the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是队里最好的球员。
words.en: used to say that something is almost certain or very likely

words.ex: The cows graze in the field every morning.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛每天早上在田野里吃草。
words.en: To graze means to feed on grass or to touch something lightly in passing.

words.ex: The goat eats grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在田野里吃草。
words.en: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and some have long hair.

words.tr:
n. 照片；相片；
v. 拍照；
words.ex: He showed me a photograph of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他给我看了他狗的照片。
words.en: A photograph is a picture that is made using a camera.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.ex: We went on an excursion to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山区进行了短途旅行。
words.en: An excursion is a short journey or trip, especially one taken as a leisure activity.

words.ex: Love is an intangible thing.
words.ex_cn: 爱是一种无形的东西。
words.en: Something that is intangible is not able to be touched or seen, but is still important or valuable.

words.tr:
adj. 免费的；无偿的
adv. 免费地；无偿地
words.ex: You can download the software gratis from the company's website.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从公司网站免费下载该软件。
words.en: If something is done or given gratis, it is done or given without payment.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: He waved a patriotic flag during the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面爱国的旗帜。
words.en: If someone is patriotic, they feel love, loyalty, and respect for their country.

words.ex: The statesman spoke wisely to calm the nation.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家明智地讲话以安抚国家。
words.en: A statesman is a respected political leader or figure, especially one who has had a long and successful career in politics.

words.ex: I bought some milk, and incidentally, I saw your friend.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一些牛奶，顺便见到了你的朋友。
words.en: used to add something to what was said before, often something that you have just thought of

words.ex: The monetary policy affects prices.
words.ex_cn: 货币政策影响价格。
words.en: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.

words.ex: He showed indifference to his friend's problems.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友的问题表现出冷淡。
words.en: Indifference is the state of being indifferent, especially in the sense of not caring or being uninterested.

words.ex: He is aware of the danger.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到危险。
words.en: If you are aware of something, you know about it.

words.tr:
v. 夺取；一把抓住
n. 夺取；一把抓住；音乐片段
words.ex: He tried to snatch the bag from her hand.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从她手中抢走包。
words.en: If you snatch something, or if you snatch at it, you take it or pull it away quickly.

words.ex: The two countries formed an alliance to fight the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家结成联盟以对抗敌人。
words.en: An alliance is a group of countries or political parties that are formally united and working together because they have similar aims.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He drinks coffee at a small cafe.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小咖啡馆喝咖啡。
words.en: A cafe is a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: The helicopter flew over the city.
words.ex_cn: 直升机飞过了城市。
words.en: A helicopter is a type of aircraft that derives both lift and propulsion from one or more sets of horizontally revolving overhead rotors. It is capable of moving vertically and horizontally, the direction of motion being controlled by the pitch of the rotor blades.

words.tr:
adj. 爆炸的；
n. 炸药；
words.ex: The explosive material was handled with care.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸性材料被小心地处理。
words.en: An explosive substance is capable of causing an explosion. It can also refer to something that is likely to cause an outburst or a sudden increase in activity or emotion.

words.ex: He makes occasional visits to his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他偶尔去看望祖父母。
words.en: Occasional means happening or done sometimes, but not regularly or often.

words.tr:
adj. 季度的；
adv. 每季一次；
words.ex: The company releases its quarterly report every three months.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每三个月发布一次季度报告。
words.en: Something that happens quarterly happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲处；
v. （使）弯曲；
words.ex: The car turned at the bend in the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在道路的拐弯处转弯了。
words.en: To bend something means to change its shape so that it is no longer straight but curved.

words.tr: n. 食品贮藏室；食品贮藏柜
words.ex: She keeps cookies in the pantry.
words.ex_cn: 她把饼干放在食品储藏室里。
words.en: A pantry is a small room or closet in a house, usually near the kitchen, where food, dishes, linens, and provisions are stored.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.ex: The medicine helped revive the sick man.
words.ex_cn: 这剂药帮助这位病人恢复了生机。
words.en: To revive something means to bring it back to life, consciousness, or use, or to make it active or successful again.

words.ex: The fence marks the boundary between the two gardens.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏标志着两个花园的分界线。
words.en: A boundary is a real or imagined line that marks the edge or limit of something.

words.ex: His judgement was fair and smart.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断公正而明智。
words.en: The ability to make considered decisions or come to sensible conclusions.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: He ate a walnut for a healthy snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一颗胡桃作为健康零食。
words.en: A walnut is the nut of the walnut tree, which has a hard, wrinkled shell and a two-lobed, edible kernel.

words.ex: The soldiers loaded ammunition into their guns.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们把弹药装进枪里。
words.en: Ammunition refers to the projectiles and propelling charges used in guns, firearms, or any other weapons.

words.ex: The air is clean after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气很清新。
words.en: Air is the invisible gaseous substance surrounding the earth, a mixture mainly of oxygen and nitrogen.

words.ex: He saw a beautiful panorama from the mountain top.
words.ex_cn: 他从山顶看到了美丽的全景。
words.en: A panorama is a view of a wide area, or a description or study that presents all the different parts or aspects of a particular subject.

words.ex: The company will reimburse you for your travel expenses.
words.ex_cn: 公司会报销你的旅行费用。
words.en: If you reimburse someone for something, you pay them back the money that they have spent or lost because of it.

words.ex: The correspondent reported the news from the city.
words.ex_cn: 记者从城市报道了新闻。
words.en: A correspondent is someone who reports news from a particular place or on a particular subject for a newspaper, magazine, or television or radio station.

words.ex: The team was unanimous in choosing the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 团队在选择新领导时意见完全一致。
words.en: When a group of people are unanimous, they all agree about something or all vote for the same thing.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.ex: The two companies showed good cooperation on the project.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司在这个项目上表现出良好的合作。
words.en: Cooperation is the process of working or acting together, which can be seen in many aspects of life, including business, science, and social interactions.

words.tr: adj. 圆圈的；环形的；循环的；
words.ex: The table has a circular top.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子有一个圆形的桌面。
words.en: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

words.tr:
v. 喜欢；享受；从…获得乐趣
n. 享受；乐趣；调味品
words.ex: He relishes every bite of his favorite food.
words.ex_cn: 他享受着每一口他最喜欢的食物。
words.en: If you relish something, you enjoy it very much.

words.ex: He went to his grandfather's funeral.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加了他祖父的葬礼。
words.en: A funeral is a ceremony that is held because someone has died.

words.ex: His negligence caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: Negligence is failure to take proper care over something that you are responsible for, which might cause damage or loss.

words.tr: adj. 傲慢的；高傲自大的
words.ex: He gave a haughty smile when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得奖品时露出了傲慢的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as haughty, you mean that they behave in a proud, unfriendly way, because they think that they are better than other people.

words.ex: Good coordination between teams improves work efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 团队之间的良好协调能提高工作效率。
words.en: The organization of the different elements of a complex body or activity so as to enable them to work together effectively.

words.ex: The void on the page made the text look empty.
words.ex_cn: 页面上的空白让文字看起来空荡荡的。
words.en: If you describe a situation or a feeling as a void, you mean that it seems empty because there is nothing interesting or worthwhile about it.

words.tr: v. 使麻痹；使瘫痪；使无效；使停止活动
words.ex: The snake bite paralyse his arm.
words.ex_cn: 蛇咬使他的手臂麻痹。
words.en: If someone is paralysed by an accident or an illness, they have no feeling in their body, or in part of their body, and are unable to move.

words.ex: He took a pill for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒药丸来缓解头痛。
words.en: A pill is a small solid mass of medicine that you swallow whole.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.ex: He has an allergy to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: An allergy is a condition in which your immune system reacts abnormally to a foreign substance.

words.tr: adj. 失败的；夭折的；发育不完全的
words.ex: The abortive plan failed before it started.
words.ex_cn: 这个失败的计划在开始前就失败了。
words.en: Failing to produce the intended result; unsuccessful.

words.ex: The nobility lived in large castles and owned much land.
words.ex_cn: 贵族住在大城堡里，拥有大量土地。
words.en: The quality of being noble in character, mind, birth, or rank.

words.ex: The children played on the deck of the ship.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在船的甲板上玩耍。
words.en: A deck is a floor-like surface on a ship, or a set of cards used in games. It can also mean to decorate or adorn something.

words.ex: The company will employ five new workers next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将雇佣五名新员工。
words.en: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

words.ex: The big rock was an obstacle on the road.
words.ex_cn: 那块大石头是路上的障碍。
words.en: An obstacle is something which makes it difficult for you to go forward or to achieve something.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.tr:
n. 紧握；掌握；控制；
v. 紧握；掌握；
words.ex: He has a strong grip on the handle.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧握住把手。
words.en: To grip something means to hold it tightly. It can also mean to hold someone's attention completely.

words.ex: The lion lives in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子生活在丛林中。
words.en: A jungle is a dense, tropical forest that is home to a wide variety of plants and animals.

words.tr: n. 象牙；象牙色 adj. 象牙色的
words.ex: The old piano has ivory keys.
words.ex_cn: 这架旧钢琴有象牙键。
words.en: Ivory is a hard, white material from the tusks and teeth of animals, which is used to make or decorate objects.

words.ex: Birds migrate south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 鸟类在冬天迁徙到南方。
words.en: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

words.ex: The snake has a deadly bite.
words.ex_cn: 这种蛇的咬伤是致命的。
words.en: If something is deadly, it is likely or able to cause someone's death, or has already caused someone's death.

words.ex: He emphasizes the importance of homework.
words.ex_cn: 他强调作业的重要性。
words.en: To give special importance or prominence to (something) in speaking or writing.

words.ex: Please fetch me a glass of water.
words.ex_cn: 请给我拿一杯水来。
words.en: If you fetch something or someone, you go to the place where they are and return with them.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.tr: v. 销声匿迹；突然消失；
words.ex: The magic trick made the coin vanish.
words.ex_cn: 这个魔术让硬币销声匿迹了。
words.en: If someone or something vanishes, they disappear suddenly or in a way that cannot be explained.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.tr: adj. 难以捉摸的；不易被抓获（觉察、理解或记忆）的；
words.ex: The truth remained elusive.
words.ex_cn: 真相难以捉摸。
words.en: Difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or understand.

words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.ex: The teacher will inspect our homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会检查我们的作业。
words.en: If you inspect something, you look at it very carefully, usually in order to find out something about it.

words.ex: The birds live in a quiet marsh.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟生活在一片宁静的沼泽中。
words.en: A marsh is an area of low-lying land which is flooded in wet seasons or at high tide, and typically remains waterlogged at all times.

words.ex: Plants release oxygen into the air.
words.ex_cn: 植物向空气中释放氧气。
words.en: A colourless, odourless reactive gas, the chemical element of atomic number 8 and the life-supporting component of the air.

words.ex: He will inevitably fail if he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 如果他不学习，他不可避免地会失败。
words.en: If something will inevitably happen, it is certain to happen and cannot be prevented or avoided.

words.ex: The plumber fixed the leaky pipe.
words.ex_cn: 水管工修好了漏水的管道。
words.en: A plumber is a person whose job is to connect and repair things such as water and drainage pipes, baths, and toilets.

words.ex: The team's morale improved after they won the game.
words.ex_cn: 球队赢了比赛后，士气提升了。
words.en: Morale is the amount of confidence and cheerfulness that a group of people have.

words.tr: adj. 首要的；小学的；初等的；原来的；最初的；
words.ex: Primary goal is to stay safe.
words.ex_cn: 首要目标是保持安全。
words.en: Something that is primary is more important than anything else.

words.ex: The children played in a small grove behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的小树林里玩耍。
words.en: A grove is a small group of trees.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.tr:
v. 想要；
adj. 花哨的；昂贵的；
n. 爱好；
words.ex: I fancy a cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我想要一杯茶。
words.en: If you describe something as fancy, you mean that it is special, unusual, or elaborate, often because it has a lot of decoration or is very expensive.

words.ex: He is frugal with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱很节俭。
words.en: If you describe someone as frugal, you mean that they are careful about spending money and use things only when they need to.

words.tr:
adj. 成熟的；
v. 成熟；
words.ex: He is a mature student who works full-time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成熟的学生，全职工作。
words.en: When something or someone matures, they become fully grown or developed. In finance, a mature investment is one that has reached the end of its term and is ready to be paid out.

words.ex: The sunset was spectacular.
words.ex_cn: 日落非常壮观。
words.en: Something that is spectacular is very impressive or dramatic.

words.ex: He will not forsake his family.
words.ex_cn: 他不会抛弃他的家人。
words.en: If you forsake someone, you leave them when you should have stayed, or you stop helping them or looking after them.

words.tr: n. 取消；撤销；作废；中止；
words.ex: The flight cancellation made us wait for a new ticket.
words.ex_cn: 航班取消让我们不得不等待新的机票。
words.en: The act of cancelling something; a situation in which something that has been arranged is stopped from happening.

words.ex: The coffee had a strong bitterness.
words.ex_cn: 这杯咖啡有很重的苦味。
words.en: Bitterness is the quality of having a sharp, pungent taste or of feeling angry and unhappy because of bad experiences.

words.ex: He fractured his arm during the soccer game.
words.ex_cn: 他在足球比赛中摔断了手臂。
words.en: If something such as a bone fractures or is fractured, it breaks or cracks.

words.ex: The soldiers defend their country from enemies.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫自己的国家免受敌人入侵。
words.en: To defend means to protect someone or something from attack, harm, or criticism. It can also involve arguing in support of someone or something.

words.tr: n. 噩梦；不愉快的经历；
words.ex: He had a nightmare about falling from a tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个从高楼坠落的噩梦。
words.en: A nightmare is a very frightening dream.

words.tr:
n. 仙子；小精灵；
adj. 幻想中的；
words.ex: The little girl saw a fairy in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 小女孩在花园里看到了一位仙子。
words.en: A fairy is a mythical being of folklore and romance usually having magic powers and dwelling on earth in close relationship with humans.

words.ex: The sailors cleaned the stern of the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手们打扫了船尾。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as stern, you mean that they are severe or strict.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: The room has good ventilation through the windows.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间通过窗户有良好的通风。
words.en: The provision of fresh air to a room, building, etc., or the system that does this.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.ex: He lost his keys yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天丢了钥匙。
words.en: If you lose something, you no longer have it or you cannot find it.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.ex: The bank keeps money in a vault.
words.ex_cn: 银行把钱存放在金库里。
words.en: A vault is an arched structure that forms a ceiling or roof, or a room, especially in a church, that has an arched ceiling or roof. It can also refer to a jump over something using your hands or a pole to push yourself off the ground.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: Honesty is a great virtue.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一种伟大的美德。
words.en: A virtue is a good quality or way of behaving.

words.tr:
v. 猜测；猜想；
n. 猜测；猜想；
words.ex: I guess it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我猜明天会下雨。
words.en: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: The rubber band shows great elasticity when stretched.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋被拉伸时表现出很大的弹性。
words.en: The ability of an object or material to resume its normal shape after being stretched or compressed.

words.ex: The slow internet frustrates me.
words.ex_cn: 慢速的网络让我感到沮丧。
words.en: If something frustrates you, it upsets or angers you because you are unable to deal with the problems it creates.

words.ex: Exercise can strengthen your muscles.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的肌肉。
words.en: To strengthen something means to make it stronger or more effective.

words.ex: The graph shows a linear relationship between time and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这张图显示了时间与距离之间的线性关系。
words.en: Linear means involving or relating to a straight line or lines.

words.ex: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
words.ex_cn: 他向我保证工作会按时完成。
words.en: If you give someone an assurance that something is true or will happen, you say that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, in order to make them feel less worried.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.tr: n. 伙伴关系；情谊；团体；联谊会；研究生奖学金
words.ex: They formed a fellowship to work on the project together.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了伙伴关系一起来做这个项目。
words.en: A fellowship is a group of people who join together for a common purpose or interest, or a financial grant given to a scholar to allow them to study or research at an advanced level.

words.ex: He engraves his name on the ring.
words.ex_cn: 他把名字刻在戒指上。
words.en: To engrave means to cut or carve a design or letters into a hard surface, or to be strongly impressed in someone's memory.

words.tr: n. 住处；膳宿；(交通工具内的)空间；
words.ex: The hotel provided cheap accommodation for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 酒店为旅客提供了便宜的住处。
words.en: Accommodation is a place where someone lives or stays, or the act of providing someone with a place to live or stay.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.ex: The boy has an abnormal heartbeat.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩的心跳不正常。
words.en: Deviating from what is normal or usual, typically in a way that is undesirable or worrying.

words.tr:
v. 嘲笑；讥讽
n. 嘲笑；讥讽
words.ex: He sneered at her simple answer.
words.ex_cn: 他嗤之以鼻地对待她的简单答案。
words.en: If you sneer at someone or something, you express your contempt for them by the expression on your face or by what you say.

words.ex: The mechanic tightened the bolt with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用扳手拧紧了螺栓。
words.en: A bolt is a type of fastener consisting of a threaded pin or rod with a head at one end, designed to be inserted through holes in assembled parts and tightened by a nut from the other end. It can also refer to a sudden dash or run, or to eat food quickly and without chewing.

words.ex: He gave a verbal warning instead of a written one.
words.ex_cn: 他给了一个口头警告，而不是书面的。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of words.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.ex: He infringes the rules by arriving late.
words.ex_cn: 他因迟到而违反了规则。
words.en: To infringe means to violate or break a law, agreement, or right.

words.tr: adj. 广大的；广阔的；广泛的；大量的；
words.ex: He has extensive knowledge of history.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有广博的历史知识。
words.en: Something that is extensive covers a wide area or includes a lot of things.

words.ex: The law obliges drivers to wear seat belts.
words.ex_cn: 法律迫使司机系安全带。
words.en: If you are obliged to do something, you have to do it because the situation, the law, a duty, etc., makes it necessary.

words.ex: She has an extraordinary talent for music.
words.ex_cn: 她具有非凡的音乐天赋。
words.en: Something that is extraordinary is very unusual or remarkable.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.tr:
v. 跌倒；摔倒；暴跌
n. 摔倒；混乱；暴跌
words.ex: The child tumble down the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 孩子从楼梯上跌倒了。
words.en: If someone or something tumbles, they fall quickly and suddenly, often turning over or spinning as they fall.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.ex: We decorate the room for the party.
words.ex_cn: 我们为派对装饰房间。
words.en: To make something look more attractive by putting things on it or around it.

words.ex: The camel walks across the desert.
words.ex_cn: 骆驼穿越沙漠。
words.en: A desert is a large area of land that has very little water and very few plants growing on it. Many deserts are covered by sand. If you desert someone or something, you leave them and no longer help or support them.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.ex: He used a clamp to hold the wood together.
words.ex_cn: 他用夹具把木头固定在一起。
words.en: A clamp is a device that holds two things firmly together. As a verb, to clamp means to hold or fasten something tightly.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.ex: He despises lying.
words.ex_cn: 他鄙视撒谎。
words.en: If you despise something or someone, you dislike them and have a very low opinion of them.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.tr: adj. 又黑又脏的；昏暗的；肮脏的
words.ex: The room was dingy and small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间又脏又小。
words.en: If you describe a place or thing as dingy, you mean that it is rather dull and depressing to look at, and perhaps also dirty.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: This apple is a variant of the red delicious.
words.ex_cn: 这种苹果是红富士的一个变体。
words.en: A variant is something that is slightly different from other similar things.

words.ex: He tightened the screw with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 他用扳手把螺丝拧紧。
words.en: If you tighten a rule, policy, or system, you make it stricter or more efficient.

words.tr:
v. 修正；改进；“amend”的第三人称单数
n. 补偿
words.ex: He made amends for his mistake by apologizing.
words.ex_cn: 他通过道歉来修正自己的错误。
words.en: If you make amends when you have harmed someone, you show that you are sorry by doing something to please them.

words.tr:
adj. 古老的；
n. 古董；
words.ex: He bought an antique chair from the old market.
words.ex_cn: 他从旧市场买了一把古老的椅子。
words.en: Something that is antique is old and often valuable because it is rare or well made.

words.ex: The benevolent man gave food to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 这位慈善的人给穷人提供了食物。
words.en: If you describe a person in authority as benevolent, you mean that they are kind and fair.

words.ex: The elevation of his skills helped him get a better job.
words.ex_cn: 他技能的提升帮助他找到了一份更好的工作。
words.en: The height to which something is elevated or to which it rises.

words.ex: The revival of traditional music brought joy to many people.
words.ex_cn: 传统音乐的复兴给许多人带来了快乐。
words.en: The process of something becoming popular or active again after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.ex: The smell repels insects.
words.ex_cn: 这种气味能击退昆虫。
words.en: If something repels you, it is so unpleasant or offensive that you want to avoid it or push it away.

words.ex: The country uses metric units for weight and distance.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家使用米制单位来衡量重量和距离。
words.en: A metric is a system of measurement that uses meters, liters, and grams as its basic units.

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.ex: The new law will supersede the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将取代旧法律。
words.en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

words.tr:
n. 嘲笑；嘲弄
v. 嘲笑；狼吞虎咽
words.ex: His joke received a scoff from the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他的笑话引来了人群的嘲笑。
words.en: If you scoff at something, you speak about it in a way that shows you think it is ridiculous or inadequate.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.ex: The potter shaped the clay into a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 陶匠把黏土塑造成一个碗。
words.en: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material that contains hydrous aluminium phyllosilicates (clay minerals) that develops plasticity when wet.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动
n. 摇摆；爱说笑的人
words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: If a dog wags its tail, it moves its tail from side to side, often because it is happy or excited.

words.ex: The child rides a pony in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在公园里骑小马。
words.en: A pony is a small horse.

words.ex: This school uses a progressive teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校使用一种先进的教学方法。
words.en: A progressive person or idea is one that is modern and new, and is interested in change and improvement.

words.tr: n. 运动；动作；活动；乐章；
words.ex: The movement of the sun changes the shadow.
words.ex_cn: 太阳的运动改变了影子。
words.en: The act or process of moving or being moved; a change of position or place.

words.ex: He tried to dispel the fear with calm words.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用平静的话语消除恐惧。
words.en: To dispel something such as a fear, belief, or idea means to make it disappear or to make people stop believing it.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: He uses an efficient way to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用一种高效的方法解决数学问题。
words.en: If something or someone is efficient, they are able to do tasks successfully, without wasting time or energy.

words.tr: adj. 庸俗的；粗俗的；粗野的；下流的
words.ex: He used a vulgar word in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上说了一个粗俗的词。
words.en: If you describe something as vulgar, you mean that it is in bad taste or of poor quality.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr:
n. 流量；流动；变动
v. 熔化；熔解；流出
words.ex: The flux of water through the pipe is very high.
words.ex_cn: 管道中水的流量非常高。
words.en: Flux is a state of constant change or a flow of liquid.

words.ex: He rubbed his belly after eating too much.
words.ex_cn: 他吃完太多后揉了揉腹部。
words.en: The belly is the front part of a person's or animal's body between the chest and the legs.

words.ex: The soldiers defended the fortress from enemy attacks.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们保卫堡垒，抵御敌人的进攻。
words.en: A fortress is a large building or complex of buildings used as a military stronghold.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: She added bleach to the white shirt to make it brighter.
words.ex_cn: 她往白衬衫里加了漂白剂，让它更亮。
words.en: To bleach something means to make it white or pale by using a chemical or by exposing it to sunlight.

words.ex: They stayed at a motel near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在高速公路旁的一家汽车旅馆。
words.en: A motel is a hotel which is designed for people who are travelling by car, usually with parking spaces next to each room.

words.ex: He has the capacity to solve hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: The capacity of a place or container is the amount of things or people that it can hold.

words.ex: He will overtake the car ahead soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会超过前面的车。
words.en: If you overtake someone, you go past them because you are moving faster than they are.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.tr:
v. 反驳；回嘴
n. 反驳；顶嘴
words.ex: He gave a quick retort when she criticized him.
words.ex_cn: 当她批评他时，他迅速回了一句。
words.en: If you retort, you reply angrily to someone.

words.tr:
v. 振翼；颤动；飘动；挥动
n. 鼓翼；飘扬；激动不安
words.ex: The flag is fluttering in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 旗帜在风中飘扬。
words.en: If something thin or light flutters, or if you flutter it, it moves up and down or from side to side with a lot of quick, light movements.

words.tr:
adv. 彻底地；立刻地；
adj. 完全的；彻底的；
words.ex: He refused the offer outright.
words.ex_cn: 他彻底拒绝了这个提议。
words.en: If something is done outright, it is done completely and without any hesitation or attempt to hide it.

words.ex: His denial of the mistake made everyone angry.
words.ex_cn: 他否认错误，让所有人都生气了。
words.en: A denial is a statement that something is not true or does not exist.

words.ex: The hotel has a five-star grade.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店有五星级别的等级。
words.en: A grade is a level of quality, rank, or value, or a mark given in an examination or for school work.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 一双；一对；
v. （使）配对；
words.ex: He bought a pair of shoes for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他为儿子买了一双鞋。
words.en: A pair of things are two things of the same size and shape that are intended to be used together, or that are regarded as a unit.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: The knight held up his shield to block the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 骑士举起盾牌来挡箭。
words.en: A shield is a piece of armor held in the hand or worn on the arm to protect the body from missiles or blows. It can also refer to something that protects or defends someone or something from harm or danger.

words.ex: He likes to study philosophy in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在空闲时间学习哲学。
words.en: Philosophy is the study or creation of theories about basic things such as the nature of existence, knowledge, and thought, or about how people should live.

words.ex: The water valve is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 这个水阀坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A valve is a device attached to a pipe or a tube which controls the flow of air or liquid through it.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.ex: He invests money in stocks.
words.ex_cn: 他投资股票。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by putting it in a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: He will delete the old file.
words.ex_cn: 他会删除那个旧文件。
words.en: To delete something means to remove it or erase it.

words.ex: He looked up the country in an atlas.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图册里查找那个国家。
words.en: An atlas is a book of maps or charts.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；最重要的；
n. 校长；负责人；
words.ex: The principal reason for his success is hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的主要原因是努力工作。
words.en: The person with the highest authority or most important position in an organization, institution, or group.

words.ex: He speaks fluent English.
words.ex_cn: 他讲一口流利的英语。
words.en: If someone is fluent in a particular language, they can speak it easily and correctly.

words.ex: He persevered despite many failures.
words.ex_cn: 尽管多次失败，他仍然坚持不懈。
words.en: If you persevere with something, you keep trying to do it and do not give up, even though it is difficult.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.ex: The city improved its drainage system after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 洪水之后，这座城市改进了它的排水系统。
words.en: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

words.ex: She adores her little brother.
words.ex_cn: 她非常喜爱她的弟弟。
words.en: If you adore someone, you feel great love and admiration for them.

words.tr: n. 保护；节约（自然资源）；
words.ex: The park is for the conservation of wild animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园是为了保护野生动物。
words.en: The protection and preservation of the natural environment and wildlife.

words.ex: He is a conscientious student who always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个尽责的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is conscientious is very careful to do their work properly.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The merit of this plan is its simplicity.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划的优点是简单。
words.en: If something has merit, it has good or worthwhile qualities.

words.tr: adj. 令人激动的；使人兴奋的； v. “excite”的现在分词；
words.ex: The football match was exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这场足球赛令人激动。
words.en: If something is exciting, it makes you feel very happy or enthusiastic.

words.ex: He wrote an article about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一篇关于气候变化的文章。
words.en: An article is a piece of writing on a particular subject in a newspaper, magazine, or online. It can also refer to a particular item or object, or a clause in a legal document.

words.ex: The diver submerge to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员潜水去探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid, especially water. If something submerges, it goes below the surface of a liquid.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.tr: adj. 悲惨的；不幸的；难过的；恶劣的
words.ex: He felt wretched after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wretched, you mean that they are in a very bad or unfortunate situation.

words.ex: The aggregation of raindrops formed a small puddle.
words.ex_cn: 雨滴的聚集形成了一个小水坑。
words.en: An aggregation is a collection or a group of things or people, often gathered together for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.ex: He read a biography of Nelson Mandela.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于纳尔逊·曼德拉的传记。
words.en: A biography is a detailed description of a person's life. It involves more than just the basic facts like education, work, relationships, and death; it portrays a person's experience of these life events.

words.ex: The Earth rotates around its axis.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕其轴旋转。
words.en: An axis is an imaginary line through the middle of something, especially one that it turns around.

words.ex: The validity of the test results is important.
words.ex_cn: 测试结果的有效性很重要。
words.en: The quality of being logically or factually sound; soundness or cogency.

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.ex: He deceived his friend with a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个谎言欺骗了朋友。
words.en: If you deceive someone, you make them believe something that is not true, usually in order to get some advantage for yourself.

words.ex: He is undoubtedly the best student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他无疑是班上最好的学生。
words.en: Without doubt; certainly.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.tr: v. 进行；继续；继续进行；“proceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting is proceeding as planned.
words.ex_cn: 会议按计划进行。
words.en: A proceeding is an event or a series of actions, especially one that is formal or official.

words.ex: They celebrated their wedding anniversary with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们用晚餐庆祝结婚纪念日。
words.en: An anniversary is a date which is remembered or celebrated because a special event happened on that date in a previous year.

words.ex: The two shadows are overlapping on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 两个影子在地板上交叠。
words.en: If one thing overlaps another, or if you overlap them, a part of the first thing occupies the same area as a part of the other thing.

words.ex: The teacher instructed the students to open their books.
words.ex_cn: 老师指示学生打开书。
words.en: To instruct someone means to tell or teach them to do something, especially in a formal or official way.

words.ex: He found a shortcut to school.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一条去学校的捷径。
words.en: A quicker or more direct way to get somewhere or do something.

words.tr:
adj. 高位的；高尚的；欣喜的
v. 赞扬；提升；加强；“exalt”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The exalted king sat on a golden throne.
words.ex_cn: 这位高位的国王坐在一张金宝座上。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as exalted, you mean they are at a high level of honor, rank, or quality.

words.ex: There was an array of people at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 音乐会上人山人海。
words.en: An array of different things or people is a large number or wide range of them.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.ex: The clearance of trash improved the park's appearance.
words.ex_cn: 清理垃圾改善了公园的外观。
words.en: Clearance refers to the process of removing or getting rid of something, or the space that is needed for one thing to move past another. It can also refer to the permission given for something to happen or be done.

words.ex: Please inform me when the meeting starts.
words.ex_cn: 请在会议开始时通知我。
words.en: To inform someone means to tell them about something.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.tr:
v. 投入；跳入
n. 跳进；骤降
words.ex: He plunged into the cold water.
words.ex_cn: 他跳进了冰冷的水里。
words.en: If something or someone plunges in a particular direction, especially into water, they fall, rush, or throw themselves in that direction.

words.ex: His behavior at the party was very polite.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上的举止非常礼貌。
words.en: The way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others.

words.ex: Hydrogen is the lightest element.
words.ex_cn: 氢是最轻的元素。
words.en: Hydrogen is a chemical element with symbol H and atomic number 1. With a standard atomic weight of 1.008, hydrogen is the lightest element in the periodic table.

words.tr:
v. 拍动；摆动；
n. 薄片；
words.ex: The bird flaps its wings to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟拍动翅膀飞翔。
words.en: A flap is a piece of cloth, paper, skin etc that is fixed at one edge to a surface, which you can lift up easily. If something such as a piece of cloth or paper flaps or if you flap it, it moves quickly up and down or from side to side.

words.ex: The spaceship flew to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船飞到了月球。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for travel or operation in outer space.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.tr: adj. 放任的；纵容的；许可的
words.ex: Her parents are permissive and let her stay out late.
words.ex_cn: 她的父母很宽容，让她很晚才回家。
words.en: A permissive person, society, or system allows people a lot of freedom to do what they want.

words.ex: A hawk flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹰飞过田野。
words.en: A hawk is a bird of prey with a strong beak and sharp claws, known for its keen vision and swift flight. As a verb, to hawk means to sell goods aggressively, often in public places.

words.tr:
v. 乱摸；摸索；笨手笨脚地做
n. 摸索；笨手笨脚
words.ex: He fumbled for his keys in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他在黑暗中乱摸着找钥匙。
words.en: If you fumble with something, you try to hold, move, or find it with your hands in a clumsy way.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.ex: The foundation gives money to poor students.
words.ex_cn: 这个基金会向贫困学生提供资金。
words.en: The foundation of something such as a belief or way of life is the things on which it is based.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.tr:
n. 闪耀；闪烁；小发光物
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）
words.ex: The glitter of the stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星的闪耀照亮了夜空。
words.en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

words.ex: The car depreciates every year.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车每年都会贬值。
words.en: If something such as a currency depreciates or if something depreciates it, it loses some of its original value.

words.tr:
n. 轭；枷锁；束缚
v. 上轭；使强行结合
words.ex: The farmer put a yoke on the oxen.
words.ex_cn: 农夫给牛套上了轭。
words.en: A yoke is a wooden bar that is fastened over the necks of two animals, especially cattle, and connected to the vehicle or load that they are pulling. It can also refer to something that binds people together or something that people find oppressive.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The instructions confuse me.
words.ex_cn: 这些说明让我感到困惑。
words.en: If you confuse two things, you mix them up in your mind so that you think one is the other.

words.tr:
v. 测量；衡量；度量；
n. 衡量；量度；措施；
words.ex: He uses a ruler to measure the length of the table.
words.ex_cn: 他用尺子测量桌子的长度。
words.en: To measure something means to determine its size, amount, or degree, often by using a tool or device designed for this purpose.

words.ex: He is conversant with basic math.
words.ex_cn: 他熟悉基础数学。
words.en: If you are conversant with something, you are familiar with it and able to deal with it.

words.ex: The renaissance brought new art and ideas to Europe.
words.ex_cn: 文艺复兴为欧洲带来了新的艺术和思想。
words.en: The Renaissance was a period in European history marking the transition from the Middle Ages to modernity and covering the 15th and 16th centuries, characterized by an effort to revive and surpass ideas and achievements of classical antiquity.

words.ex: He will flee from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 他会从着火的房子里逃走。
words.en: If you flee from something or someone, you leave them quickly because you are afraid of them or because you do not want to be involved with them.

words.ex: She made an embroidery of a flower on the pillow.
words.ex_cn: 她在枕头上绣了一朵花。
