words.en: A shipwreck is the destruction of a ship at sea by sinking or breaking up, for example in a storm or after hitting a rock.

words.ex: He is zealous about helping others.
words.ex_cn: 他热心帮助别人。
words.en: If someone is zealous, they are enthusiastic and eager about something, especially something they believe in very strongly.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.ex: They ascribe his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他们把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you ascribe an event or condition to a particular cause, you say or consider that it was caused by that thing.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.tr: adj. 同时发生的；巧合的；一致的；相符合的
words.ex: The two events were coincident.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是同时发生的。
words.en: Happening at the same time or in the same place; corresponding in nature or time.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: Drugs can relieve pain.
words.ex_cn: 药物可以减轻疼痛。
words.en: To relieve someone or something means to make a problem, pain, or unpleasant feeling less severe or to take it away completely.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.ex: He uses aluminum foil to wrap the food.
words.ex_cn: 他用铝箔纸包食物。
words.en: A light, silvery metal that is used especially for making cooking equipment and aircraft parts.

words.ex: His comprehension of the story was very good.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个故事的理解很好。
words.en: Comprehension is the ability to understand something.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.ex: The children played on the gravel path.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在砾石小路上玩耍。
words.en: Gravel consists of very small stones. It is often used to make paths and roads.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.tr:
v. 促进；使增长；
n. 提高；增强；
words.ex: Exercise can boost your energy.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进你的精力。
words.en: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

words.tr:
n. 违背；
v. 攻破；
words.ex: The company committed a breach of contract.
words.ex_cn: 该公司违反了合同。
words.en: A breach of a law, rule, or agreement is an act of breaking it.

words.ex: He was frank about his mistakes.
words.ex_cn: 他坦率地承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If someone is frank, they state or express things in an open and honest way.

words.ex: The judge showed mercy and let him go free.
words.ex_cn: 法官仁慈地让他自由了。
words.en: If someone in authority shows mercy, they choose not to harm someone they have power over, or they forgive someone they have the right to punish.

words.ex: The government decided to codify the old laws.
words.ex_cn: 政府决定将旧法律编纂成典。
words.en: To codify means to arrange laws, rules, etc. into a systematic code.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: The meaning of the poem is obscure.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的意思不清楚。
words.en: If something is obscure, it is not well known or not easily understood.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.tr:
v. 使腐败；
adj. 腐败的；
words.ex: The official was corrupt by taking bribes.
words.ex_cn: 这位官员因收受贿赂而腐败。
words.en: If someone is corrupt, they do things that are dishonest or illegal in order to gain money or power.

words.ex: He embarrassed himself in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班同学面前让自己丢脸了。
words.en: If you embarrass someone, you make them feel shy, ashamed, or guilty about something.

words.tr: v. 趟水；涉水；艰苦地进行
words.ex: He wades through the shallow river.
words.ex_cn: 他涉水走过浅河。
words.en: To walk through water or another liquid or soft substance that impedes movement.

words.ex: The adverse weather delayed the flight.
words.ex_cn: 不利的天气延误了航班。
words.en: If something is adverse, it is harmful or unfavorable.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.tr:
v. 牵引；拖
n. 牵引；拖
words.ex: He tows his broken car to the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把坏掉的车拖到修理厂。
words.en: To pull a vehicle or boat along behind another vehicle, using a rope or chain.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.tr:
n. 奖励；报酬；
v. 奖励；回报；
words.ex: He got a reward for winning the contest.
words.ex_cn: 他因赢得比赛而得到了奖励。
words.en: Something given or received in return for a deed or service rendered.

words.ex: The volcano erupts suddenly.
words.ex_cn: 火山突然喷发。
words.en: If a volcano erupts, it throws out smoke, fire, and melted rocks.

words.ex: The insider told the news about the company's plan.
words.ex_cn: 这位局内人透露了公司计划的消息。
words.en: An insider is someone who is a member of a group or organization, and therefore has special knowledge about it.

words.tr:
n. 愚蠢的错误；失误
v. 犯愚蠢的错误；失误；跌跌撞撞地走
words.ex: He made a big blunder in the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中犯了一个大错误。
words.en: A blunder is a stupid or careless mistake.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.tr: v. 使遭危险或伤害；危害；危及
words.ex: Pollution can endanger animals.
words.ex_cn: 污染会危及动物。
words.en: To put someone or something at risk or in danger.

words.tr:
n. 绝望；
v. 绝望；
words.ex: He felt despair after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到绝望。
words.en: Despair is the feeling that everything is wrong and that nothing will improve.

words.tr: adj. 坚决的；毅然的；有决心的；
words.ex: He was resolute in his decision to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他决心戒烟。
words.en: If you describe someone as resolute, you approve of them because they are very determined not to change their mind or not to give up a course of action.

words.tr:
n. 制造；
v. （用机器大量）制造；虚构；捏造；
words.ex: The manufacture of cars needs many workers.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的制造需要很多工人。
words.en: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.ex: It was a mere mistake, not intentional.
words.ex_cn: 那只是一个小小的错误，并非故意的。
words.en: You use mere to emphasize how unimportant or inadequate something is, in comparison to the general situation you are describing.

words.tr: n. 受公众注意的程度；简介；轮廓；
words.ex: The celebrity's profile rose after the TV interview.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人经过电视采访后，受公众注意的程度提高了。
words.en: A profile is a side view of something, especially a person's face, or a brief description of someone or something.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: She seeks perfection in everything she does.
words.ex_cn: 她在所做的每件事中都追求完美。
words.en: The state of being perfect; the highest degree of excellence or quality.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.ex: The ball is a perfect sphere.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是一个完美的球体。
words.en: A sphere is a perfectly round three-dimensional shape, like a ball. It can also refer to a particular area of interest, activity, or knowledge.

words.tr:
n. 怨恨；积怨；嫌隙
v. 勉强做；不情愿地给；吝惜
words.ex: He holds a grudge against his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他对他哥哥心怀怨恨。
words.en: A grudge is a persistent feeling of ill will or resentment resulting from a past insult or injury.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.ex: He submitted the documentation for his project.
words.ex_cn: 他提交了项目的文件。
words.en: Documentation refers to the act of providing documents or the documents themselves, which serve as evidence or records of something.

words.ex: The movie was tame and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影枯燥无味。
words.en: If you describe an animal as tame, you mean that it is not afraid of humans and is not dangerous. If you describe a person or their behavior as tame, you mean that they are not very exciting or interesting.

words.ex: He loves studying geology in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在高中学习地质学。
words.en: The science which deals with the physical structure and substance of the earth, their history, and the processes which act on them.

words.ex: Add a dash of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 给汤里加一点盐。
words.en: If you dash somewhere, you run or go there quickly and suddenly. A dash is a straight, horizontal line used in writing, for example to separate two main clauses whose meanings are closely connected.

words.ex: He wakes up at six every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点醒来。
words.en: To wake means to stop sleeping or to cause someone to stop sleeping. It can also refer to the trail left by a moving ship.

words.ex: The merchant sells fresh fruit every morning.
words.ex_cn: 商人每天早上卖新鲜水果。
words.en: A merchant is a person who buys and sells goods, especially one who owns a shop.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish or command.

words.ex: The farmer tried to kill the pest with a spray.
words.ex_cn: 农民试图用喷雾杀死害虫。
words.en: A pest is an animal or insect that damages crops, food, or livestock, or is generally troublesome. It can also refer to a person or thing that causes annoyance or trouble.

words.ex: His generosity helped the poor family.
words.ex_cn: 他的慷慨帮助了那个贫困的家庭。
words.en: Generosity is the quality of being kind and generous.

words.ex: The ticket is invalid because it expired.
words.ex_cn: 这张票无效，因为它已经过期了。
words.en: If something is invalid, it is not legally or officially acceptable, or it is not based on truth or reason.

words.ex: He will restore the old bike.
words.ex_cn: 他将修复这辆旧自行车。
words.en: To restore something means to bring it back to its original condition or to a state of health, efficiency, or good management.

words.ex: The sweater shrinks in hot water.
words.ex_cn: 这件毛衣在热水中会收缩。
words.en: If something shrinks or you shrink it, it becomes smaller.

words.tr:
n. 意图；目的；
adj. 专注的；
words.ex: His intent was to help, not to hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助，而不是伤害。
words.en: If you are intent on doing something, you are determined to get it done. If you have an intent to do something, you have a plan or purpose in mind.

words.tr:
adj. 小数的；十进位的
n. 小数
words.ex: The decimal point separates the whole number from the decimal part.
words.ex_cn: 小数点将整数部分与小数部分分开。
words.en: A decimal is a fraction that is written in a special form. It is based on powers of ten, and it uses a decimal point to separate the whole number part from the fractional part.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 东西；原料；
v. 塞；填充；
words.ex: I need to clean up all this stuff.
words.ex_cn: 我需要清理这些东西。
words.en: If you stuff something somewhere, you push it there quickly and roughly. If you stuff a container or space with something, you fill it completely with that thing.

words.ex: The police started an investigation into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An investigation is a careful search or examination in order to discover facts or information.

words.ex: He deliberately broke the rule.
words.ex_cn: 他有意地违反了规则。
words.en: If you do something deliberately, you do it intentionally or after thinking about it carefully.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: He read the preface before starting the book.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始读这本书之前读了序言。
words.en: A preface is an introduction at the beginning of a book, which explains what the book is about or why it was written.

words.ex: The farmer piled up fodder for the cows.
words.ex_cn: 农夫为奶牛堆了一堆饲料。
words.en: Fodder is food that is given to cows, horses, and other animals.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.ex: He is a former teacher who now works as a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名以前的老师，现在是一名作家。
words.en: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

words.ex: The king abrogated the old law.
words.ex_cn: 国王废除了旧法律。
words.en: If someone in a position of authority abrogates something such as a law, agreement, or practice, they put an end to it.

words.tr:
n. 耸肩
v. 耸肩
words.ex: He shrugged when asked why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到为什么迟到时，他耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you shrug, you raise your shoulders to show that you are not interested in something or that you do not know or care about something.

words.ex: He found a dime on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上找到一枚一角硬币。
words.en: A dime is a coin worth ten cents, one tenth of a United States dollar.

words.tr:
v. 喘气；喘息
n. 气喘；喘息
words.ex: He panted after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: To breathe quickly and loudly through your mouth, usually because you have been doing something energetic.

words.ex: He is a carrier of the flu virus.
words.ex_cn: 他是流感病毒的携带者。
words.en: A carrier is a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: The car runs on petroleum.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车使用石油运行。
words.en: A naturally occurring, yellow-to-black liquid found in geological formations beneath the Earth's surface, which is commonly refined into various types of fuels.

words.ex: A bug crawled on the leaf.
words.ex_cn: 一只小虫子爬在叶子上。
words.en: A bug is a small insect, or it can refer to a fault in a computer program or system.

words.ex: The earthquake was a catastrophe.
words.ex_cn: 这场地震是一场灾难。
words.en: An event causing great and often sudden damage or suffering; a disaster.

words.tr:
n. 倒塌；崩溃；暴跌；
v. 倒塌；崩溃；
words.ex: The collapse of the old bridge caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧桥的倒塌引起了诸多问题。
words.en: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

words.ex: His ingenuity solved the problem with a simple tool.
words.ex_cn: 他的独创力用一个简单的工具解决了问题。
words.en: Ingenuity is the ability to think of clever and original ways to solve problems.

words.ex: He ate soup from a bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃汤。
words.en: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are often used for washing or other purposes.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr: n. 减缓；宽慰；解脱；救济；
words.ex: The medicine brought relief to his pain.
words.ex_cn: 这种药缓解了他的疼痛。
words.en: Relief is a feeling of reassurance and relaxation following release from anxiety or distress.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.ex: He waved a red banner in the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面红旗子。
words.en: A banner is a long strip of cloth with a message or design on it, used especially for advertising or as a symbol of a particular group or cause.

words.tr:
n. 广播节目；电视节目；
v. 广播；播送；
words.ex: I listened to the morning broadcast on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我听了早上的广播节目。
words.en: To broadcast is to transmit (a program or some information) by radio or television.

words.tr:
v. 蹲伏；蜷缩
n. 蹲伏；蜷缩
words.ex: The cat crouched low to catch the mouse.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹲伏下来抓老鼠。
words.en: If you crouch, you bend your legs so that you are close to the ground and leaning forward slightly.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.ex: He has a good reputation for honesty.
words.ex_cn: 他以诚实著称。
words.en: The opinion that people have about someone or something because of what has happened in the past.

words.ex: The two companies will merge next year.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司明年将合并。
words.en: To combine or unite to form a single entity.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: The utilization of solar energy is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 太阳能的利用正在增加。
words.en: Utilization is the act of using something effectively.

words.ex: She adds yeast to make bread rise.
words.ex_cn: 她加入酵母使面包发酵膨胀。
words.en: Yeast is a type of fungus which is used to make bread rise and to make beer and wine.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: There is a disparity in pay between men and women.
words.ex_cn: 男女之间的工资存在差异。
words.en: A disparity between two or more things is a noticeable difference between them.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.ex: He adapted to the new school quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就适应了新学校。
words.en: To make suitable to or fit for a specific use or situation.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built pyramids for their kings.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人为他们的国王建造了金字塔。
words.en: A pyramid is a monumental structure with a square or triangular base and sloping sides that meet in a point at the top, especially one built of stone as a royal tomb in ancient Egypt.

words.ex: He duly submitted his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他适时地按时交了作业。
words.en: If something is duly done, it is done in the correct way or at the correct time; properly.

words.tr:
adj. 最终的；最后的；
n. 决赛；
words.ex: This is the final answer.
words.ex_cn: 这是最终的答案。
words.en: Last in a series or coming at the end of a process.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: He ordered a steak for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐点了一份牛排。
words.en: A steak is a slice of meat, especially beef, that is cooked by grilling or frying.

words.tr:
n. 回顾；复习；审查；评论；
v. 回顾；复习；审核；评论；
words.ex: We had a quick review of last week's lesson.
words.ex_cn: 我们对上周的课程做了一个简短的回顾。
words.en: If you review something, you consider it again, especially in order to make changes to it or to give your opinion about it.

words.ex: The water supply is insufficient for the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对整个村庄来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is insufficient, it is not enough for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 无产阶级的；n. 无产者
words.ex: The proletarian worked long hours in the factory.
words.ex_cn: 普罗在工厂里长时间工作。
words.en: A proletarian is a member of the proletariat, the class of wage-earners in a capitalist society whose only possession of significant material value is their labor-power.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.tr: n. 寄生虫；寄生生物；依赖他人过活者；
words.ex: The parasite lives inside the host's body.
words.ex_cn: 这种寄生虫生活在宿主的体内。
words.en: A parasite is an organism that lives on or in a host organism and gets its food from or at the expense of its host.

words.ex: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中有数不清的星星。
words.en: Too many to be counted; very many.

words.ex: He is an architect who designs houses.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位设计房屋的建筑师。
words.en: An architect is a person who designs buildings and advises in their construction.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.ex: The hikers walked along the ridge of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者沿着山脊行走。
words.en: A ridge is a long, narrow elevation of land, or a raised strip.

words.ex: The location of the store is near the park.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店的位置在公园附近。
words.en: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: Many people died of starvation during the famine.
words.ex_cn: 许多人在饥荒中饿死了。
words.en: Starvation is a severe deficiency in caloric energy intake, below the level needed to maintain an organism's life.

words.ex: The stomach digests food into nutrients.
words.ex_cn: 胃将食物消化成营养物质。
words.en: To digest means to break down food in the stomach and intestines into substances that can be absorbed by the body. It can also mean to understand or assimilate information. As a noun, it refers to a compilation or summary of information.

words.ex: He entreats his friend to help him.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求朋友帮助他。
words.en: To ask someone earnestly or anxiously to do something.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.tr: n. 黄昏；薄暮；暮光；衰退期
words.ex: The birds fly home at twilight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在黄昏时飞回家。
words.en: The time of day immediately following sunset, or the period of time at the end of the day when the sun is just below the horizon, especially the period between sunset and dark.

words.ex: The willow grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 柳树长在河边。
words.en: A willow is a type of tree with long, thin branches and narrow leaves that grows near water.

words.ex: He revised his answer to make it correct.
words.ex_cn: 他修正了他的答案，使其正确。
words.en: To revise something means to alter or amend it, especially in order to correct or improve it.

words.ex: Smoking is detrimental to your health.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟对你的健康有害。
words.en: Something that is detrimental has a harmful or damaging effect on something else.

words.ex: The provincial government opened a new school.
words.ex_cn: 省政府开设了一所新学校。
words.en: Relating to a province or provinces; having the manners, viewpoints, etc., considered characteristic of unsophisticated inhabitants of a province; narrow-minded.

words.ex: He ate ham for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了火腿。
words.en: Ham is meat from the upper part of a pig's leg that has been preserved with salt or smoke.

words.ex: The doctor will certify that you are healthy.
words.ex_cn: 医生将证明你身体健康。
words.en: To officially declare something to be true, correct, or genuine, often in writing.

words.ex: He amended the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送信件之前修正了它。
words.en: To amend something means to make changes to it in order to improve it or make it more accurate.

words.ex: This phone is superior to the old one.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机比旧的更好。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as superior, you mean that they are better than other people or things.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.ex: The floor was filthy after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨过后，地板变得非常肮脏。
words.en: Something that is filthy is extremely dirty.

words.ex: The pitcher threw the ball fast.
words.ex_cn: 投掷的人把球投得很快。
words.en: A pitcher is a player in baseball who throws the ball to the batter. It can also refer to a large container with a handle and a lip, used for holding and pouring liquids.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.tr: n. 颂歌；赞美诗；欢乐之歌；
words.ex: The children sang a Christmas carol at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上唱了一首圣诞颂歌。
words.en: A carol is a religious song or popular hymn, particularly one associated with Christmas.

words.ex: The two teams clashed during the match.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍在比赛中发生了冲突。
words.en: A clash is a loud, harsh noise, like the clash of cymbals. It can also refer to a conflict or disagreement.

words.ex: The small town is located in the hinterland of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇位于该国的内地。
words.en: The area lying inland from a coast or the shore of a river; the backcountry.

words.ex: His discourse on climate change was clear and logical.
words.ex_cn: 他关于气候变化的论述清晰而有逻辑。
words.en: Discourse is spoken or written communication between people, especially serious discussion of a particular subject.

words.ex: The company made the adoption of new technology quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司迅速采用了新技术。
words.en: The act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or the act of accepting something new.

words.ex: His lapse in judgment caused the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的疏忽导致了事故。
words.en: A lapse is a temporary failure or a slight error, or the process by which something gradually passes into a different state, especially a worse one.

words.ex: He wrote a memo to remind the team.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一封备忘录提醒团队。
words.en: A memo is a short official note that is sent by one person to another within the same company or organization.

words.ex: The team canvass voters for their opinions.
words.ex_cn: 团队征询选民的意见。
words.en: To canvass means to ask people for their votes or opinions, especially in a political context, or to examine something carefully.

words.ex: His rude behavior alienated his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的行为使朋友们疏远了他。
words.en: To cause someone to feel isolated or estranged; to transfer the ownership of property to another.

words.ex: The miller ground wheat into flour every morning.
words.ex_cn: 磨坊主每天早上把小麦磨成面粉。
words.en: A miller is a person who owns or works in a mill, especially a grain mill.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.ex: Plants need nitrogen to grow.
words.ex_cn: 植物需要氮来生长。
words.en: A chemical element with the symbol N and atomic number 7. It is a colorless, odorless, tasteless gas that is the most plentiful element in Earth's atmosphere and is a constituent of all living tissues.

words.tr: n. 代人临时照看婴孩者
words.ex: She works as a baby-sitter on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 她在周末做保姆。
words.en: A person paid to look after a child or children while the parents are away.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon, a common utensil.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起了一把勺子，一种常见的餐具。
words.en: An utensil is a tool that you use in your home, especially in the kitchen, for example, a knife, fork, or spoon.

words.ex: I ate an apple as a snack after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后吃了一个苹果当小吃。
words.en: A snack is a small amount of food that is eaten between meals.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.ex: He showed reluctance to speak in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他表现出不愿意在全班面前讲话。
words.en: Reluctance is an unwillingness to do something.

words.tr: n. 锦标赛；冠军赛；冠军的身份；
words.ex: He won the championship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年赢得了锦标赛。
words.en: A championship is a competition to find the best player or team in a particular sport or game.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.tr:
n. 猛跌；衰退；萧条期
v. 急剧下降；暴跌；重重地坐下（或倒下）
words.ex: The company's sales went into a slump last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月，这家公司的销售额下滑了。
words.en: If something such as the value of something slumps, it falls suddenly and by a large amount.

words.ex: The landscape after the rain is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 雨后的景色非常美丽。
words.en: A landscape is all the visible features of an area of land, often considered in terms of their aesthetic appeal.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.ex: The workers used a hoist to lift the heavy beams.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用吊升机械吊起沉重的梁。
words.en: To hoist something means to lift or pull it up to a higher position, usually using some kind of equipment such as a crane or pulley.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.tr: adj. 有竞争力的；竞争的；
words.ex: She is a competitive runner who wins many races.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有竞争力的跑步者，赢得了许多比赛。
words.en: Competitive is used to describe situations or activities in which people or firms compete with each other.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.ex: He complains about the loud noise every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都抱怨噪音太大。
words.en: To express dissatisfaction, pain, or resentment, usually because of a particular situation or someone's actions.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: He accepted a nominal fee for the service.
words.ex_cn: 他为这项服务收取了微不足道的费用。
words.en: If you say that something is nominal, you mean that it is very small in comparison to the real value or importance of something.

words.ex: The street was full of filth after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴过后，街道上满是污秽。
words.en: Filth is a noun that refers to disgusting dirt or refuse, or obscene and offensive language or printed material.

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.tr: v. 兴旺；繁荣；茁壮成长；
words.ex: Plants thrive in sunny places.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光充足的地方茁壮成长。
words.en: To thrive means to grow or develop well or vigorously.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.ex: A plume of smoke rose from the chimney.
words.ex_cn: 一股烟从烟囱里升起。
words.en: A plume is a large, soft, feather or a group of feathers, especially one that is used as a decoration.

words.ex: The old man muttered a curse under his breath.
words.ex_cn: 老人低声嘟囔了一句诅咒。
words.en: A curse is a word or sentence that is used to wish evil or harm on someone or something.

words.tr:
adj. 肮脏恶臭的；
v. 对…犯规；
words.ex: The foul smell came from the garbage bin.
words.ex_cn: 那股恶臭来自垃圾桶。
words.en: If you describe something as foul, you mean it is dirty and smells or tastes unpleasant. In sports, a foul is an act that is against the rules of the game.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.ex: She is thrifty and saves money every week.
words.ex_cn: 她很节约，每周都存钱。
words.en: If you say that someone is thrifty, you are praising them for saving money and not spending it on unnecessary things.

words.tr:
n. 原木；航海日志；
v. （正式地）记载；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly with a large log.
words.ex_cn: 大火用一根大原木烧得很旺。
words.en: A log is a piece of a thick branch or trunk of a tree that has been cut so that it can be used for fuel or for making things. A log is also a written record of events, often on a ship or aircraft.

words.ex: The company received patronage from a local businessman.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司收到了一位本地商人的赞助。
words.en: The support, encouragement, privilege, or financial aid that an organization or individual bestows to another.

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.ex: He endow a library with books.
words.ex_cn: 他捐赠了一图书馆的书。
words.en: If someone is endowed with a particular quality or ability, they naturally have it.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.ex: He used a stapler to attach the documents together.
words.ex_cn: 他用订书机将文件订在一起。
words.en: A stapler is a device used to fasten papers together by driving a metal staple through the sheets and folding the ends.

words.tr: v. 沉思；闷闷不乐地想；n. 一窝幼崽；沉思的状态
words.ex: He sits by the window and broods over his failures.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边，为自己的失败而忧思。
words.en: If someone broods over something, they think about it a lot, seriously and often unhappily. A brood is a group of young birds all born at the same time to the same mother.

words.ex: The blacksmith heated the metal in the furnace.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠在熔炉里加热金属。
words.en: A furnace is a device that produces heat for warmth or to melt materials.

words.ex: She insists on going home now.
words.ex_cn: 她坚决要求现在回家。
words.en: If you insist on doing something, you keep doing it, even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: One apple will suffice for now.
words.ex_cn: 一个苹果现在就足够了。
words.en: If something suffices, it is enough to achieve a purpose or to fulfill a need.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: She practices ballet every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 她每天下午练习芭蕾舞。
words.en: Ballet is a type of performance dance that originated during the Italian Renaissance in the 15th century and later developed into a concert dance form in France and Russia. It has since become a widespread, highly technical form of dance with its own vocabulary based on French terminology. It has been globally influential and has defined the foundational techniques used in many other dance genres.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He planted carrots in a small patch.
words.ex_cn: 他在一小块地上种了胡萝卜。
words.en: A patch is a piece of material used to mend a hole or a weak spot in something, or a small area that is different from the area around it.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.ex: The essence of love is caring for others.
words.ex_cn: 爱的本质是关心他人。
words.en: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: The teacher changed the parameter to make the test easier.
words.ex_cn: 老师更改了参数，使测试更容易。
words.en: A parameter is a limit or boundary which defines the scope of a particular process or activity.

words.ex: He tries to procure food for his family.
words.ex_cn: 他努力为家人获取食物。
words.en: To obtain something, especially with care or effort.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: The teacher will notify the students about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师会通知学生们关于考试的事。
words.en: If you notify someone of something, you officially inform them about it.

words.ex: The ball keeps moving because of inertia.
words.ex_cn: 球因为惯性继续移动。
words.en: Inertia is the tendency of a physical object to continue moving in a straight line at a constant speed, or to stay at rest, unless it is acted upon by a force.

words.ex: He sat in contemplation of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他凝视着日落。
words.en: Contemplation is the act of thinking deeply about something.

words.ex: The earth's crust is made of rock.
words.ex_cn: 地球的地壳由岩石组成。
words.en: The crust is the hard outer layer of something, such as bread or the Earth's surface.

words.tr: v. 同意；继承；即位；加入
words.ex: He acceded to their request.
words.ex_cn: 他同意了他们的请求。
words.en: If you accede to someone's request, you do what they ask.

words.ex: The baby is crawling on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在地板上爬。
words.en: To move slowly on hands and knees or by dragging the body close to the ground.

words.ex: His conviction that honesty is important never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他坚信诚实很重要，从未改变。
words.en: A conviction is a strong belief or opinion, or the state of being found guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: The candle's flicker lit up the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛的闪现照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.tr: n. 历史遗迹；纪念碑；不朽作品；
words.ex: The ancient monument attracts many tourists each year.
words.ex_cn: 这座古代历史遗迹每年吸引许多游客。
words.en: A monument is a large structure, usually made of stone, which is built to remind people of an important person or event.

words.tr: adj. 势利的；谄上欺下的
words.ex: He is snobbish and ignores people who are not rich.
words.ex_cn: 他很势利，不理睬不富有的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as snobbish, you disapprove of them because they are too proud of their social status, intelligence, or taste.

words.ex: His motivation is to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他的动机是帮助他人。
words.en: Motivation is the enthusiasm or reason for doing something.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.tr:
n. 筛子；滤器
v. 筛；滤
words.ex: He used a sieve to separate sand from pebbles.
words.ex_cn: 他用筛子把沙子和石子分开。
words.en: A sieve is a tool consisting of a wire or plastic mesh held in a frame, used for separating solids from liquids or larger particles from smaller ones.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.tr:
n. 纪录片；
adj. 文书的；
words.ex: We watched a documentary about pandas last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚看了一部关于熊猫的纪录片。
words.en: A documentary is a film or television or radio programme that gives factual information about a particular subject.

words.ex: He imparts knowledge to his students every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天向学生传授知识。
words.en: If you impart information to people, you tell it to them. To impart a particular quality to something means to give it that quality.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；非常宝贵的；
words.ex: Her advice was invaluable to me.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对我而言是无价的。
words.en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

words.ex: Practice can sharpen your skills.
words.ex_cn: 练习可以提高你的技能。
words.en: To make or become sharp or sharper.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: It's ridiculous to think he can run a mile in one minute.
words.ex_cn: 认为他能在一分钟内跑完一英里是荒谬的。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is ridiculous, you mean that they are very foolish.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: This is a good instance of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An instance is a particular example or case of something.

words.tr: adj. 逐渐的；逐步的；渐进的；
words.ex: The change was gradual.
words.ex_cn: 这种变化是逐渐的。
words.en: A gradual change or process happens in small stages over a long period of time, rather than suddenly.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.tr:
v. 吼叫；咆哮
n. 吼叫；咆哮
words.ex: The lion let out a loud roar.
words.ex_cn: 狮子发出了一声响亮的咆哮。
words.en: If something roars, it makes a very loud noise, like the sound of a lion.

words.ex: He stood amid the trees, quiet and still.
words.ex_cn: 他站在树木中间，安静而静止。
words.en: If something is amid other things, it is surrounded by them.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr:
n. 树篱；防范措施
v. 用树篱围住；限制；避免
words.ex: He planted a hedge around his garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园周围种了一排树篱。
words.en: A hedge is a row of bushes or small trees which have been planted along the edge of a garden, field, or road to separate it from another area or to protect it. As a verb, to hedge means to avoid committing oneself or to limit or qualify something by conditions or exceptions.

words.ex: He stared in amazement at the magic trick.
words.ex_cn: 他惊讶地盯着那个魔术。
words.en: Amazement is the feeling you have when something surprises you very much.

words.ex: The old house looks ugly with broken windows.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老房子有破窗户，看起来很丑陋。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is ugly, you mean that they are very unattractive and unpleasant to look at.

words.ex: The weather can dictate what we wear each day.
words.ex_cn: 天气可以支配我们每天穿什么。
words.en: To dictate means to say or read something aloud for someone else to write down, or to give orders in an authoritative manner.

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: His arrogance made others dislike him.
words.ex_cn: 他的傲慢让其他人不喜欢他。
words.en: Arrogance is the quality of being arrogant, which means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.

words.tr: n. 一阵强劲的气流；爆炸；
words.ex: A blast of cold wind hit the window.
words.ex_cn: 一阵冷风击中了窗户。
words.en: A blast is a sudden loud noise or a strong gust of wind. It can also refer to an explosion or the act of blowing something up. As a verb, it means to explode or to criticize severely.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: He spoke with clear diction.
words.ex_cn: 他说话吐字清晰。
words.en: Diction refers to the choice and use of words and phrases in speech or writing, or the manner in which words are pronounced.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.ex: His answer was apt for the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答对这个问题很恰当。
words.en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

words.tr: adj. 眼花缭乱的；耀眼的； v. “dazzle”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dazzling lights of the city made her blink.
words.ex_cn: 城市的耀眼灯光让她眨了眨眼。
words.en: If you describe something as dazzling, you mean that it is extremely impressive, beautiful, or skilful.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.ex: He has an inclination to help others.
words.ex_cn: 他有帮助他人的倾向。
words.en: An inclination is a feeling that makes you want to act in a particular way, or a tendency to do something.

words.ex: The statue is made of white marble.
words.ex_cn: 这座雕像由白色大理石制成。
words.en: Marble is a type of very hard rock which is used for making statues and for building. It is usually white with dark lines in it.

words.ex: The barometer shows that the weather will be fine.
words.ex_cn: 晴雨表显示天气会很好。
words.en: A barometer is an instrument that measures atmospheric pressure, used especially in forecasting the weather and determining altitude.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.tr: n. （政治、商业或社会性）活动；运动；
words.ex: The city launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市发起了一项减少塑料垃圾的活动。
words.en: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.tr:
adj. 疲倦的；厌烦的
v. （使）厌倦；厌烦
words.ex: He looked weary after working all day.
words.ex_cn: 他工作了一整天后看起来很疲惫。
words.en: If you are weary, you are very tired.

words.tr:
n. 样品；样本；
v. 抽样；
words.ex: The scientist tested the sample from the river.
words.ex_cn: 科学家测试了来自河流的样品。
words.en: A sample is a small quantity of a product, especially food, given to customers so that they can try it before buying it.

words.ex: He found an old manuscript in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他在图书馆里发现了一份旧手稿。
words.en: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

words.ex: He earned the esteem of his colleagues through hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力工作赢得了同事们的尊重。
words.en: If you esteem someone or something, you respect or admire them.

words.ex: The generator provides electricity during the power outage.
words.ex_cn: 发电机在停电时提供电力。
words.en: A generator is a machine which produces electricity or another form of energy.

words.tr: n. 储蓄金；存款；“saving”的复数；
words.ex: He used his savings to buy a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他用他的储蓄买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Money that someone has saved, especially in a bank or official scheme.

words.ex: I sympathize with people who are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 我同情那些挨饿的人。
words.en: If you sympathize with someone who is in a bad situation, you feel sorry for them.

words.tr:
adv. 顺时针方向地
adj. 顺时针方向的
words.ex: Turn the knob clockwise to open the jar.
words.ex_cn: 顺时针转动旋钮来打开罐子。
words.en: Moving in the same direction as the hands of a clock.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；怀疑的；拿不准的；
words.ex: The deal seemed dubious to me.
words.ex_cn: 这个交易在我看来很可疑。
words.en: If you describe something as dubious, you mean that you do not consider it to be completely honest, safe, or reliable.

words.ex: The teacher bought a replacement for the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 老师买了一把新椅子来替换坏掉的椅子。
words.en: The act of replacing something or someone, or the thing or person that replaces them.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: The astronomer looks at stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 这位天文学家通过望远镜观察星星。
words.en: An astronomer is a scientist who studies celestial bodies such as planets, stars, and galaxies.

words.ex: He will install the new software on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他将在他的电脑上安装新软件。
words.en: To set up or fix in position for use or service.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr: adv. 笨拙地；局促不安地；尴尬地
words.ex: He walked awkwardly after his injury.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路很不自然。
words.en: In a manner that is not graceful or elegant in movement or shape; clumsily.

words.ex: The engineer checked the specification for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了机器的规格。
words.en: A specification is a detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

words.ex: He needs authorization to enter the room.
words.ex_cn: 他需要获得授权才能进入房间。
words.en: Authorization is the act of giving someone the power or right to do something.

words.ex: The new tool enables him to finish work faster.
words.ex_cn: 这个新工具使他能够更快地完成工作。
words.en: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity or means to do it.

words.tr:
v. 派遣；调遣；发送
n. 快信；发送；派遣
words.ex: He will dispatch the package tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会寄出这个包裹。
words.en: To send someone or something to a particular place for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The recurrence of storms caused many problems.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的反复出现造成了许多问题。
words.en: The return of a sign, symptom, or disease after a remission.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.tr:
adj. 一致的；统一的；
n. 制服；
words.ex: The students wear a uniform shirt to school.
words.ex_cn: 学生们穿一致的衬衫去学校。
words.en: A uniform is a special set of clothes which some people, for example soldiers or the police, wear to work in and which some children wear at school. It is also used to describe something that is the same in all parts and does not vary.

words.ex: The unfair verdict caused public outrage.
words.ex_cn: 不公正的判决引发了公众的愤怒。
words.en: An outrage is an extremely strong reaction of anger, shock, or indignation.

words.ex: The teacher gave clear instruction on how to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了如何解决这个问题的明确教授。
words.en: Detailed information telling how something should be done, operated, or assembled.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.ex: He will mend his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他将修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: If you mend something that is broken or damaged, you repair it, so that it works properly or so that it looks like new again.

words.ex: The country has a budget deficit this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年这个国家的预算不足额。
words.en: A deficit is the amount by which something, especially a sum of money, is too small.

words.ex: He walked home with his companion.
words.ex_cn: 他和同伴一起走回家。
words.en: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

words.tr:
n. 主人；主持人；
v. 主持；
words.ex: The host welcomed us with tea and cookies.
words.ex_cn: 主人用茶和饼干欢迎了我们。
words.en: A host is a person who receives or entertains guests, especially in their own home. A host is also a person who presents a television or radio program.

words.ex: He made a mistake in haste.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙中犯了一个错误。
words.en: Haste is the quality of doing something quickly, sometimes too quickly so that you are careless and make mistakes.

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.tr: v. 使相混；使联结；交际
words.ex: He mingled the two colors to make a new one.
words.ex_cn: 他把两种颜色混合在一起，创造出一种新颜色。
words.en: If things such as sounds, smells, or feelings mingle, they mix or combine with each other, or if people mingle, they talk to each other at a social event.

words.ex: The hikers faced great peril in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者在风暴中面临巨大危险。
words.en: Peril refers to serious and immediate danger.

words.tr:
v. 侮辱；辱骂
n. 侮辱；辱骂
words.ex: He insulted her with rude words.
words.ex_cn: 他用粗鲁的话侮辱了她。
words.en: To insult someone means to say or do something that is rude or offensive.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.tr: adj. 自治的；有自治权的；自主的；
words.ex: The region has autonomous control over its education system.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区对其教育系统拥有自治权。
words.en: An autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.ex: The snake made a loud hiss.
words.ex_cn: 蛇发出了响亮的嘶嘶声。
words.en: To make a sharp sound like that of the letter s prolonged, as a snake does, or as steam does when forced under pressure through a small opening.

words.ex: He bought an extravagant car that cost too much money.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆奢侈的车，价格太贵了。
words.en: Spending much more than is necessary or wise; excessively expensive.

words.ex: The school forbids students to use phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止学生在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: To forbid something means to order that it must not be done.

words.ex: They danced in the ballroom last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚他们在舞厅跳舞了。
words.en: A ballroom is a very large room that is used for dancing.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.ex: He is loyal to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他对朋友忠诚。
words.en: Someone who is loyal remains firm in their friendship or support for a person or thing.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.tr: n. 房间；室；腔；大会议室；
words.ex: He sat in the chamber and waited quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在房间里安静地等待。
words.en: A chamber is a large room, especially one that is used for formal or public events.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.ex: The children played in the woods after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在树林里玩耍。
words.en: Woods are areas of land covered with trees, often used for walking or enjoying nature.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: The magnet shows strong magnetism.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁显示出很强的磁性。
words.en: Magnetism is a physical phenomenon produced by the motion of electric charge, resulting in attractive and repulsive forces between objects.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一颗漂亮的珠宝。
words.en: A jewel is a precious stone that is used to decorate valuable objects such as rings or necklaces.

words.tr:
n. 疑虑；怀疑
v. 使疑虑；使担忧；“misgive”的现在分词
words.ex: He had a misgiving about the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个计划感到不安。
words.en: A misgiving is a feeling of doubt or anxiety about something that might happen or might have happened.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: He likes all fruits, notably apples.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢所有水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: You use notably to specify an important or typical example of something that you are talking about.

words.tr:
v. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
n. 闲逛；散步；漫步；
words.ex: They stroll in the park after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们晚饭后在公园里闲逛。
words.en: If you stroll somewhere, you walk there in a slow, relaxed way.

words.tr: n. 听力；听觉； v. 听；听见；“hear”的现在分词；
words.ex: His hearing is getting worse with age.
words.ex_cn: 他的听力随着年龄增长而变差。
words.en: The ability to perceive sounds; a session in which evidence and arguments are presented to a court or committee.

words.tr: adj. 精力充沛的；茂盛的；
words.ex: He is a vigorous man who runs every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个精力充沛的人，每天早上都跑步。
words.en: A vigorous person does things with great energy and enthusiasm. A vigorous campaign or activity is done with great energy and enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.ex: The pupil writes with a pencil in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个小学生在课堂上用铅笔写字。
words.en: A pupil is a child or young person who is being taught in a school or by a private tutor.

words.tr:
v. 费力地做；苦干；跋涉
n. 苦工；劳累的工作
words.ex: He toils in the field every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在田里辛苦劳作。
words.en: If you toil, you work very hard doing something that is difficult or tiring.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The kangaroo jumps high in the Australian wild.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠在澳大利亚的野外跳得很高。
words.en: A kangaroo is a large Australian animal which moves by jumping on its back legs. Female kangaroos carry their babies in a pouch on their stomach.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.ex: He took an oath to tell the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓要说出真相。
words.en: An oath is a formal promise, especially one made in a court of law or a religious ceremony, or a swear word.

words.ex: He keeps apples in the cellar.
words.ex_cn: 他把苹果存放在地窖里。
words.en: A cellar is a room underneath a house, often used for storing things such as wine or coal.

words.tr: adj. 装饰性的；作装饰用的；
words.ex: The room has decorative flowers on the table.
words.ex_cn: 房间里桌上有一些装饰性的花。
words.en: Something that is decorative is intended to look pretty or attractive.

words.ex: Please tell me beforehand if you can't come.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不能来，请提前告诉我。
words.en: If you do something beforehand, you do it earlier than a particular event.

words.tr:
v. 伸展；延伸；持续；
n. 一段；伸展；
words.ex: He stretches his arms every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上伸展手臂。
words.en: To stretch is to extend your body or a part of your body to its full length, or to extend something else to its full length or beyond its normal limits.

words.ex: The legend says a dragon lives in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 传说有一条龙住在山里。
words.en: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true or may be imaginary.

words.tr: adj. 冒犯的；令人不快的；进攻性的；
words.ex: His offensive words made her cry.
words.ex_cn: 他冒犯的话让她哭了。
words.en: If you describe someone's language or behavior as offensive, you mean that it is rude or insulting.

words.ex: They collaborate to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们合作完成这个项目。
words.en: to work jointly with others or together especially in an intellectual endeavor

words.ex: He sent a malicious email to hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他发了一封怀恶意的邮件来伤害他的朋友。
words.en: If you describe someone's words or actions as malicious, you mean that they are intended to harm people or their reputation, or to cause them embarrassment and upset.

words.ex: He took a provisional job until he found a better one.
words.ex_cn: 他在找到更好的工作之前做了一份临时工作。
words.en: Something that is provisional is temporary and likely to be changed or replaced in the future.

words.tr: adj. 雄辩的；有口才的；有说服力的
words.ex: He gave an eloquent speech at the ceremony.
words.ex_cn: 他在仪式上发表了富有感染力的演讲。
words.en: If you describe someone as eloquent, you mean that they are able to express their ideas and opinions well, so that other people understand them and are influenced by them.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 漂移；
words.ex: The drift of the river carries leaves downstream.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流动将树叶冲向下游。
words.en: If something or someone drifts somewhere, they move there slowly or gradually. As a noun, drift can refer to a slow, gradual movement or change, or the general meaning or intent of something.

words.ex: The judge will uphold the law.
words.ex_cn: 法官将维护法律。
words.en: If you uphold something such as a law, a principle, or a decision, you support and maintain it.

words.ex: The smell of the food made her feel nausea.
words.ex_cn: 食物的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: A feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

words.ex: I am somewhat tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 下班后我有点累。
words.en: You use somewhat to indicate that something is the case to a limited extent or degree.

words.ex: He is absolutely sure about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他绝对确定这个答案。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: The bridge has a stone arch.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥有一个石拱。
words.en: An arch is a structure that is curved at the top and is usually made of stone or brick. Arches are often used to support the weight of a bridge or the roof of a building.

words.tr: adv. 大幅度地；相当地；很大地；
words.ex: The price has increased considerably.
words.ex_cn: 价格大幅上涨了。
words.en: To a notably large or significant extent.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: n. 晶体管；晶体管收音机
words.ex: The radio uses a small transistor.
words.ex_cn: 这个收音机使用了一个小晶体管。
words.en: A transistor is a semiconductor device used to amplify or switch electronic signals and electrical power.

words.ex: He lost consciousness after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了意识。
words.en: The state of being aware of and able to think about oneself, one's surroundings, and one's experiences.

words.ex: He must confront his fears.
words.ex_cn: 他必须面对自己的恐惧。
words.en: If you confront a difficult situation or issue, you accept the fact that it exists and try to deal with it.

words.ex: The child recites the poem every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子每天早上背诵这首诗。
words.en: To repeat aloud or declaim (a poem or passage) from memory before an audience.

words.ex: The two roads diverge after the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 两条路在桥后分岔。
words.en: If one thing diverges from another similar thing, the first thing becomes different from the second or develops differently from it. You can also say that two things diverge.

words.ex: He wrote a draft of the letter before sending it.
words.ex_cn: 他在发送之前写了这封信的草稿。
words.en: A draft is a preliminary version of a piece of writing, or a current of air in a room or other confined space. It can also refer to the act of selecting someone for a particular purpose or task, especially in sports or the military.

words.ex: The fireworks at night were a beautiful spectacle.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的烟花是一场美丽的奇观。
words.en: A spectacle is a visually striking performance or display.

words.ex: Climbing the mountain was an arduous task.
words.ex_cn: 爬山是一项艰巨的任务。
words.en: Something that is arduous is difficult and tiring, and involves a lot of effort.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.ex: He rarely eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: Not often; seldom.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.tr:
adj. 精瘦的；精简的；不景气的；
v. 倾斜；倚靠；
words.ex: The dog is lean and fast.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗精瘦而敏捷。
words.en: If you lean in a particular direction, you bend your body in that direction. If you lean on or against someone or something, you rest against them so that they partly support your weight. If you describe someone as lean, you mean that they are thin but look strong and healthy. If you describe a period of time as lean, you mean that it is a time when people have very little of something, especially money.

words.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。
words.en: An acquaintance is someone you know a little, who is not a close friend.

words.tr:
n. 绷带
v. 用绷带包扎
words.ex: He put a bandage on his cut finger.
words.ex_cn: 他在他割伤的手指上贴了绷带。
words.en: A bandage is a piece of material used to cover a wound or to support an injured part of the body.

words.ex: Water is a common solvent for salt.
words.ex_cn: 水是盐的常见溶剂。
words.en: A solvent is a substance that can dissolve other substances, or a person or company that has enough money to pay their debts.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.ex: He hurled the ball across the field.
words.ex_cn: 他猛地把球投过球场。
words.en: To throw something with great force; to shout something loudly.

words.ex: The canary sings beautifully in the cage.
words.ex_cn: 金丝雀在笼子里唱得非常动听。
words.en: A canary is a small yellow bird which is known for its singing.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.ex: He shuns loud parties because he is shy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为害羞而避开热闹的派对。
words.en: If you shun someone or something, you deliberately avoid them or keep away from them.

words.ex: The doctor used ultrasonic waves to check the baby.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用超声波来检查婴儿。
words.en: Ultrasonic refers to sound waves with frequencies higher than the upper limit of human hearing.

words.ex: He was a pioneer in space exploration.
words.ex_cn: 他是太空探索的先驱者。
words.en: A pioneer is someone who is one of the first people to do something that others will later develop or continue. Pioneers are also people who are among the first to go to live in a new area, especially in the past when people were trying to settle in new lands.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.ex: The child felt helpless when he lost his mother.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子失去妈妈时，他感到无助。
words.en: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.

words.ex: The report gives an exhaustive list of all the rules.
words.ex_cn: 这份报告给出了所有规则的详尽列表。
